# Yizuo Agent Materials Plaza（壹座·智能体素材广场）

> The outward understanding surface of the Yizuo platform: what materials exist, how the platform supplies them, and how to obtain each one. Every item below is a material — something a human or an AI agent can understand, obtain, and run. Three species: 577 agents (versioned bundles), 265 skills, 22 MCP servers (784 public tools). Canonical data: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/generated/catalog.json. As of: 2026-11-05.

## Machine surfaces

- [catalog.json](https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/generated/catalog.json): every material with a canonical brief, five-locale human summaries, whenToUse, and provenance — the annotation-layer shape this platform already runs internally.
- [infrastructure.md](https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/generated/infrastructure.md): the supply mechanism as an input–action–output table (publish / obtain / run / serve), self-contained.

# Cross-border Compliance Triage / 跨境电商合规分流团队

## What this is

跨境电商合规分流团队模板：分流员消费政策日报/通报流/ePing 逐条出分流单（四字段，只分流不裁决）→合成位管队列三态→产出位落合规日报看板草稿。装包后经壹座「团队→从模板实例化」建队；纪律来自共用层三包+值守岗包 crossborder-watch-roles（同 cell 安装）。边界：政策巡检归政策盯梢舰，物流水位归物流值守舰。

Cross-border compliance triage cluster template: the triager turns policy dailies, notice streams and ePing items into four-field triage tickets (triage only, no verdicts), the synthesizer reconciles the three-state queue, the producer lands the compliance-daily board draft. Install, then instantiate; discipline from the shared packs plus crossborder-watch-roles. Boundary: notice patrolling belongs to the policy watch cluster, port levels to the logistics watch cluster.

# Content Pipeline / 内容流水线

## What this is

官方团队模板：周流水线内容工厂——主编周一主持选题会，选题策划立项、撰稿人周二至四成稿，审校为被动岗（受委托唤醒，演示成员间横向协作的唯一通道 delegation）。演示：周节奏流水线、被动岗受委托唤醒、文档工具面；编导段为 trigger(周一)→handoff 流水线（主编→策划→撰稿）+ 撰稿 dispatch 委托审校、审校 report 上行主编。铸造上架时 packId/agents 按铸造脚本补齐；本文件是清单真源，测试钉住其必须通过 fleet 段预校验。

Official team template: a weekly-pipeline content factory — the editor-in-chief chairs the Monday topic meeting, the topic planner greenlights proposals, and the writer finishes drafts Tuesday through Thursday; the reviewer is a passive role woken by delegation, demonstrating delegation as the only channel for lateral collaboration among members. Showcases: the weekly-rhythm pipeline, passive roles woken by delegation, and the document tool surface; the orchestrated segment is a trigger(Monday)→handoff pipeline (editor→planner→writer), plus the writer dispatching review work and the reviewer reporting up to the editor. When minted and listed, packId/agents are filled in by the mint script; this file is the source of truth for the manifest, and tests pin that it must pass the fleet-section pre-validation.

# Wire · Decision Review Suite / 柏讯 · 决策复盘套件

## What this is

把「当时的判定」变成可审计的历史：决策落账（追加式、幂等、修订留痕）→ 到期按基准结算真实 alpha → 提炼反思（只注入决策者，不广播）→ 持仓体检与最近判定的一致性核查。以账本为准，不美化历史；样本不足不下结论。与决策类 pack 的分工：决策 pack 产出 Rating/TargetWeights 实例，本套件负责统一落账与复盘（语义相同，不重复实现）。

Turns 'the call made at the time' into an auditable history: decision logging (append-only, idempotent, revisions leave traces) → settlement at expiry against a benchmark for realized alpha → distilled reflection (injected only into the decision-maker, never broadcast) → portfolio check-up and consistency check against the most recent calls. The ledger is the source of truth and history is never embellished; no conclusions on insufficient samples. Division of labor with decision packs: decision packs produce Rating/TargetWeights instances, this suite handles unified logging and review (same semantics, no duplicate implementation).

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

# Wire · Equity Research Suite / 柏讯 · 个股投研套件

## What this is

个股深度投研：从取数与口径、同行与竞争、财务建模、论点综合到 13 章报告装配的完整链条。五技能对齐 FinRobot 生产版 V2 的五个在跑角色（数据/分析/建模/综合/报告）。财务与披露走柏讯服务端通道 A，价格与市值走本地通道 B，估值与统计数字一律由 fd-quant 计算面产出（不自行计算）。与「估值套件」（单点估值）、「财务底盘」套件的分工：本套件是**全链报告**，估值套件是**单点深挖**，财务底盘是**通用财务分析**。方法分歧时点位可缺（null），评级必发。

Full-chain single-stock research: data acquisition and methodology, peers and competition, financial modeling, thesis synthesis, and 13-chapter report assembly. Five skills aligned with the five running roles of FinRobot production V2 (data / analysis / modeling / synthesis / report). Financials and disclosures go through the Wire server-side channel A, prices and market caps through the local channel B, and all valuation and statistical figures are produced by the fd-quant compute plane (never computed in-house). Division of labor with the Valuation suite (single-point valuation) and the Financial Foundation suite: this suite is the full-chain report, the Valuation suite is the single-point deep dive, and the Financial Foundation suite is general-purpose financial analysis. When methods disagree, point values may be missing (null) but a rating is always issued.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

# Wire · Data Governance / 柏讯 · 数据治理

## What this is

柏讯数据治理套件：读表单收上来的数据、改错一条记录、撤销改错、查改错历史、导出 CSV。写修正必须带来源标记（source）且不得代填；撤销只置回滚标记，原始行永不改写；导出带 truncated 字段，被行数闸截断时如实告知。失败原样转述，禁止以空列表冒充无数据。

Wire data governance suite: read the data collected through forms, correct one record, undo a correction, review correction history, and export CSV. Written corrections must carry a source marker (source) and never fill values on the user's behalf; undoing only sets a rollback marker and the original row is never rewritten; exports carry a truncated field, and truncation by the row cap is reported as-is rather than passed off as complete. Failures are relayed verbatim; an empty list must never pose as 'no data'.

- Official: yes — curated by FindData

# Wire · Event-Driven / 柏讯 · 事件驱动

## What this is

柏讯事件驱动四件套：事件识别（公告列表/分类/全文三路检索，六组事件类型映射，附公告标识与日期）、事件解读（读正文抽要素：金额/比例/期限/主体/生效条件，明确与需看条件二分，结论须引原文）、历史反应统计（多窗口收益分布 + 样本量 + 分位 + 必选的反例比例，明确是历史分布不是预测）、事件跟踪（按标的/类型筛选与统计，不含预测与推荐）。与柏讯舆情和投研套件的分工：舆情看文本倾向，投研做论点综合，本套件只处理结构化事件（公告/监管/业绩），不猜情绪也不给结论。核心纪律：不预测（不给涨跌预期、不说预计影响百分比）、正文支撑（标题与分类只是检索入口）、历史分布非预测（必须同时给反例比例）、预期已计入提示。公告是事实，解读是本套件的判断，两者分开呈现。不构成投资建议。

Wire event-driven four-skill set: event identification (three-way retrieval over announcement list / classification / full text, mapped into six event-type groups, each item with announcement id and date), event reading (read the body and extract elements — amount, ratio, horizon, party, effectiveness condition — split into explicit vs conditional, every conclusion citing the original text), historical reaction statistics (multi-window return distributions + sample size + quantiles + a mandatory counterexample ratio, explicitly a historical distribution, not a forecast), and event tracking (filter and tally by symbol or event type, no forecasts or recommendations). Division of labor with the Wire sentiment and equity research suites: sentiment reads text leaning, equity research synthesizes theses, this suite only handles structured events (announcements / regulatory / earnings) — it reads no mood and draws no conclusions. Core discipline: no prediction (no up/down expectations, no projected percentage impact), body-text support (title and category are only retrieval entries), historical distribution is not prediction (the counterexample ratio must accompany it), and the 'already priced in' reminder. Announcements are facts; the reading is this suite's judgment; the two are presented separately. Not investment advice.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

Three paths, all landing the same frozen version snapshot:

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): open the market tab, search "Wire · Event-Driven", subscribe and install.

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install BX0qjZe26KJU-waLQNVS-A

- event-reading — 柏讯事件驱动 · 事件解读。当用户要求"这条公告到底说了什么""这个定增/减持/业绩预告怎么看""把公告关键条款摘出来"时使用。读公告正文（get_filing），抽取金额、比例、期限、主体、生效条件五类要素，把结论分成"正文要素直接支撑（

# Wire · Expectation Gap / 柏讯 · 预期差

## What this is

柏讯预期差四件套：互动问答提取（info-stream 的 sse-interaction 条目结构化为「投资者问题 + 公司答复」，逐条带 item_id、逐字片段与正文状态分流）、预期线索解读（指引/确认/否认/回避/措辞变化五类线索，每条带可回原文的证据，措辞变化须双条并排，线索是公司口径不是事实）、与业绩预告对照（T_qa vs T_pre vs T_act 三段时间轴逐报告期对照，数值算术只走 fd-quant 计算面，预告区间三口径并列）、缺口陈述（已验证/未验证/不可评三档合成，每条带证据链与样本量，缺样本标注「不作依据」）。覆盖边界（上游实调 2026-10-23）：上证 e 互动可用、深交所互动易上游不可用（旧 API 405、新版面 SPA 化），本套件覆盖=SSE 上市公司，深市公司不在能力内，每次输出必须声明该缺口。核心纪律：引用任何问答前先查来源健康度；禁止模型记忆补问答；结论带样本量与时间窗；不评分、不排序、不推荐、不预测。与 info-shock 套件的分工：那边做信息条目的价格影响窗口，本套件只做公司口径与自身披露的对照，不涉及价格。不构成投资建议。

Wire Expectation Gap four-skill set: interactive Q&A extraction (structures info-stream sse-interaction items into 'investor question + company answer' pairs, each with item_id, verbatim quotes and body-status triage), expectation-clue reading (five clue classes — guidance / confirmation / denial / evasion / wording change — each backed by evidence traceable to the original text; wording changes always shown as a side-by-side pair; a clue is company positioning, not fact), preannouncement cross-check (a three-segment timeline per report period — Q&A date vs preannouncement/express report vs actuals; all arithmetic goes through the fd-quant compute face; preannouncement ranges shown as lower/upper/mid), and gap statement (synthesis in three tiers — verified / unverified / not assessable — each statement with an evidence chain and sample size; missing samples are marked 'not to be relied on'). Coverage boundary (upstream live probe 2026-10-23): SSE e-interaction is available; the SZSE interaction platform is unreachable upstream (legacy API 405, new portal SPA-walled), so coverage = SSE-listed companies only, SZSE names are out of scope, and every output must state this gap. Core discipline: check source health before citing any Q&A; never fill Q&A from model memory; conclusions carry sample size and time window; no scoring, no ranking, no recommendations, no forecasts. Division of labor with the info-shock suite: that one handles price-impact windows of information items, this one only contrasts company positioning against the company's own disclosures and touches no prices. Not investment advice.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

# Wire · IC Debate / 柏讯 · 投委会

## What this is

柏讯投委会三件套：把 TradingAgents/FinRobot 写好但未接线的公司层级辩论程序做成可安装的模式——多头立论（ic-bull-case，数字只能引用证据集 evidence_id、不自造不估算、不替对手立论、把己方理由说尽）、空头立论（ic-bear-case，对称规则 + 不扭曲多头已陈述证据）、裁决（ic-adjudication，入口技能：调度双方后按四纪律给出 Rating 契约实例——冲突不给 hold 须指强弱、证据不足给 review 不降级、裁决不引用任何数字、change_my_mind 必填），并落账至决策账本（结论可被 P5 结算——这是上游两家都缺失的闭环）。诚实定位：单 agent 分角色形态，三个角色由同一模型扮演，不构成独立视角；升级形态（萬星 A2A 三 persona 串行委派，深度 3 / 并发 1 / 分钟计费）已写入技能文本属产品演进。辩论不宣称提高预测准确率，是否更准由账本结算回答。裁决为研究参考，不构成投资建议。

Wire IC Debate, a three-skill set: it turns the company-level debate procedure that TradingAgents/FinRobot spell out but never wire up into an installable pattern — a bull case (ic-bull-case: numbers may only cite evidence-set evidence_id, nothing self-invented or estimated, no arguing the opponent's side, your own case argued to its full extent), a bear case (ic-bear-case: symmetric rules, plus never distorting evidence the bull side has already stated), and an adjudication (ic-adjudication, the entry skill: after dispatching both sides it issues a Rating contract instance under four disciplines — a conflict never yields hold without stating which side is stronger and why, insufficient evidence yields review rather than a downgraded verdict, the verdict cites no numbers, change_my_mind is mandatory) — and then records the outcome to the decision ledger (conclusions can be settled by P5: the closed loop both upstream projects lack). Honest positioning: single-agent role-split form; the three roles are played by one model and are not independent perspectives; the upgrade path (Wanxing A2A serial delegation across three personas, depth 3 / concurrency 1 / per-minute billing) is written into the skill text as product evolution. The debate claims no gain in forecast accuracy — whether it is more accurate is answered by ledger settlement. Verdicts are research reference, not investment advice.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

- ic-bull-case — 柏讯投委会 · 多头立论。当用户要求对某只股票构建看多论证、写多头观点、准备投委会辩论的多方意见、把证据集收敛成"为什么该买"的最强论证，或作为 ic-adjudication 的立论阶段被调度时使用。本技能不取数、不计算、不裁决——数字只
- ic-bear-case — 柏讯投委会 · 空头立论（辩论三角色之一，与 ic-bull-case 完全对称）。当用户在投委会辩论流程中需要空头方论证、问「有什么理由不买」「多头论证哪里站不住」「估值凭什么下修」，或作为 ic-adjudication 的立论阶段被调

# Wire · Strategy Lab / 柏讯 · 策略工坊

## What this is

柏讯策略工坊四件套：策略设计（权重语义与 universe 验证）、回测解读（五条要求与三条禁止项）、风控参数（含义/量级/局限）、模拟盘督导（运行事件/权重快照/数据缺口）。与柏讯模拟交易套件的分工：那边是操作面——开账户、下单、撤单、订单历史，由对话操作技能承接；本套件是思考面——想清楚权重怎么定、回测结果怎么读、风控参数意味着什么，一切成交仍走模拟交易服务。paper-only：无真实资金；回测与模拟盘不预示未来。

Wire Strategy Lab, a four-skill set: strategy design (weight semantics and universe validation), backtest interpretation (five requirements and three prohibitions), risk-control parameters (meaning / magnitude / limitations), and paper-run supervision (run events / weight snapshots / data gaps). Division of labor with the Wire Paper Trading suite: that one is the operations plane — open accounts, place orders, cancel orders, order history, handled by conversational operation skills; this suite is the thinking plane — getting clear on how weights should be set, how to read backtest results, what risk parameters mean; every fill still goes through the paper trading service. Paper-only: no real money; backtests and paper runs do not foreshadow the future.

# Wire · Sentiment-Driven / 柏讯 · 舆情驱动

## What this is

柏讯舆情驱动三件套：把公告文本变成带原文引用、可核验、可追踪的观察维度——公告舆情审读（sentiment-document-review，逐篇打分必带引用与字符定位、多篇给分布而非平均情绪、服务拒答如实转述、低置信显式标注）、舆情转向追踪（sentiment-trend-watch，按公告发布日排布、转向点必须附对应文档、样本门槛单期 ≥3 篇且高置信 ≥2 篇、覆盖面与置信度固定两栏）、舆情与价格持仓的描述性对照（sentiment-signal-bridge，只陈述时间先后不断言因果、相关性陈述须 ≥12 对且走计算面、严禁给买卖建议与「信号」称谓）。与投研套件的分工：研报的催化剂章引用本套件分数，不重复打分（同一服务同一幂等键，重复调用命中缓存）；与策略工坊的分工：那边做信号与回测，本套件只做描述性对照不给信号。分数不预示价格、当前版本（gold-v10 / prompt v7）两轮复测置信桶单调递增、方向一致率 99.19%，但五档精档之间仍有相邻档误判，均如实标注。

Wire Sentiment, a three-skill set that turns announcement text into observable dimensions that carry verbatim quotes and can be verified and tracked — announcement sentiment review (sentiment-document-review: per-document scores must carry citations with character offsets, multiple documents yield a distribution rather than an average mood, service refusals are relayed as-is, low confidence is flagged explicitly), sentiment turn tracking (sentiment-trend-watch: scores laid out by announcement publication date, every turn point must cite its corresponding document, sample thresholds of ≥3 documents per period and ≥2 high-confidence, coverage and confidence as two fixed columns), and a descriptive comparison of sentiment against prices and holdings (sentiment-signal-bridge: states temporal order only and never asserts causality, correlation claims require ≥12 pairs and go through the compute plane, buy/sell advice and the word "signal" are strictly forbidden). Division of labor with the Equity Research suite: the report's catalysts section cites this suite's scores instead of re-scoring (same service, same idempotency key — repeat calls hit the cache); division of labor with the Strategy Lab: that side builds signals and backtests, this suite only does descriptive comparison and gives no signals. Scores do not predict prices; in the current version (gold-v10 / prompt v7) two rounds of re-testing show monotonically increasing confidence buckets and 99.19% directional agreement, yet adjacent-band confusion persists among the five fine bands — all stated as-is.

- Official: yes — curated by FindData

# Wire · Policy Transmission / 柏讯 · 政策传导

## What this is

柏讯政策传导四件套：政策识别（部委条目 source_type=ministry，读正文抽发布机关/文号/政策工具/适用范围/生效时间/执行期限/量化目标七件套，每项要素附 item_id、as_of 与经 locate_evidence 核对的逐字片段）、行业映射（政策要素→受影响行业/区域→可检验变量三段映射，变量必须在年鉴/城市/公司面板真实检索到，两档置信度：政策明示/语义推断，无变量环节进未验证清单）、区域与企业传导（事件窗与政策强度序列两条路线逐环检验，相关系数、时滞扫描、样本量与窗口随行；结论三档——已验证/不显著/未验证环节，未验证环节必须显式标注，相关系数与样本量随每条结论输出；历史统计关系非因果证明）、政策跟踪（部委条目流计数与期间对比、健康度水位、已验证链路命中登记只转引不新增结论）。核心纪律：健康度前置（引用前先查 stream_health，lag 超阈值声明信息可能不完整）、区分已验证与未验证环节（无数据的一环明示未验证，绝不默认政策必然传导）、相关系数与样本量随结论输出、不因果表述不预测。不构成投资建议。

Wire Policy Transmission four-skill set: policy identification (ministry items with source_type=ministry; read the body and extract the seven policy elements — issuing agency, document number, policy instrument, scope of application, effective date, enforcement horizon, quantified targets — each element with item_id, as_of and a verbatim quote verified through locate_evidence), industry mapping (three-stage mapping policy elements → affected industries/regions → testable variables; variables must be genuinely retrieved from the yearbook / city / firm panels, two confidence tiers — stated in the policy / inferred semantically — and any link without a variable enters the unverified list), regional and firm-level transmission testing (two routes — event windows and policy-intensity series — checked link by link, with correlation coefficients, lag scans, sample sizes and windows printed on each row; conclusions in three tiers — verified / not significant / unverified links, the latter explicitly labeled, correlation and sample size accompany every conclusion; historical statistical relations are not causal proof), and policy tracking (ministry stream counts and period comparison, health watermark, and a hit-register that merely cross-references verified chains without adding conclusions). Core discipline: health first (check stream_health before citing; over-threshold lag means declaring 'information may be incomplete'), separate verified from unverified links (a link with no data is explicitly unverified — never assume a policy must transmit), correlation and sample size accompany every conclusion, no causal wording, no forecasts. Not investment advice.

Macro cycle and conditions analysis: a six-domain indicator framework (growth / inflation / money & credit / fiscal / external trade / property & consumption) + cycle positioning (output-inflation quadrants) + leading-coincident-lagging stratification + transmission-chain reasoning + turning-point identification, with statistical testing methods for correlation and stationarity checks. Data are retrieved in real time via the Wire open-data surface and statistical yearbooks, with every figure annotated by source and data period.

# Wire · Industry-Chain Linkage / 柏讯 · 产业链联动

## What this is

柏讯产业链联动四件套：链条映射（上中下游环节可多级、代表标的与归属依据、每环关键变量与来源、两档映射置信度）、传导验证（逐环相关性 + 时滞扫描 + 样本量与窗口，未验证环节明示不默认成立，不显著如实呈现，频度差处理，非因果表述）、环节受益分析（基于已验证的传导结论给候选，逐候选项回指传导依据，未验证环节不作依据，不预测价格）、链条景气跟踪（按环节分组的变量走势 + 来源与最新期数 + 缺口标注，无预测无建议）。与既有「行业链分析」技能的关系：那是分析技能，本套件是它的可安装套件化 + 可执行出口版本（从产业链关系走到可回测的权重），不是重复实现。核心纪律：产业链叙事最容易滑向讲漂亮故事——上游涨价到中游承压再下游提价听起来总是对的，但时滞、幅度与是否发生都必须有数据支撑；无数据的那一环明示未验证。传导结论是历史统计关系不是因果证明，不构成投资建议。

Wire industry-chain linkage four-skill suite: chain mapping (multi-level upstream/midstream/downstream segments with representative names and attribution rationale, key variables and sources per segment, and two mapping-confidence tiers); transmission verification (per-segment correlations + lag scans + sample sizes and windows; unverified segments are stated as such and never assumed to hold, insignificant results reported honestly, frequency mismatches handled explicitly, no causal wording); segment-beneficiary analysis (candidates based on verified transmission conclusions, each candidate pointing back to its transmission evidence, unverified segments never used as a basis, no price forecasting); and chain-conditions tracking (variable trends grouped by segment + sources and latest periods + gap flags; no forecasts, no advice). Relation to the existing industry-chain-analysis skill: that is the analysis skill, this suite is its installable, executable-outlet form (from industry-chain relations to backtestable weights), not a duplicate implementation. Core discipline: industry-chain narratives slide most easily into pretty storytelling — upstream price rises squeezing midstream margins before downstream price hikes always sound right, but lags, magnitudes and whether it happened at all must be data-backed; segments without data are declared unverified. Transmission conclusions are historical statistical relations, not causal proof, and do not constitute investment advice.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install dxT2HEZ1z8GibrjMAgFJJw

# Baixun · Three-Lens Investment Research / 柏讯 · 投研三镜头

## What this is

三员投研团队：宏观分析（环境）、估值分析（价值）、投委会多空质询（博弈）三个独立镜头审读同一问题。团队任务下扇出聚合；单聊可切换任一角色。舆情/风控等更多角色可入动态团队叠加。

A three-role investment research team that examines one question through three independent lenses: macro analysis (the environment), valuation analysis (the value), and investment-committee bull-bear debate (the contest). Team tasks fan out across the lenses and aggregate the results; in a solo chat you can switch to any role. More roles, such as sentiment monitoring or risk control, can be layered into the dynamic team.

# Wire · Factor Selection / 柏讯 · 因子选股

## What this is

柏讯因子选股四件套：因子库与口径（52 因子九类清单、逐因子分子分母与报表期别、三个共线因子的剔除说明、数据可得性分档）、因子暴露与分层（走计算面，层数与极端值处理显式，IC 含 Pearson/Spearman，样本不足不作依据）、选股应用（多因子打分或条件筛选，产出候选 universe/目标权重，打分非预测）、无未来函数回测协议（财报用披露日而非报告期、universe 用当期成分、价格止于决策日、断言必须开启）。与自适应轮动套件的分工：轮动用价格类行业动量选组、本套件用基本面因子选股，两者可组合不重复；与个股投研套件的分工：那边做单只公司的深度报告，本套件做横截面的排序与筛选。因子值一律由计算面算出，不手算。回测为历史模拟，不构成投资建议。

Wire factor-selection four-skill suite: factor library and methodologies (a list of 52 factors in nine categories, with per-factor numerator, denominator, source statement and period, removal notes for three collinear factors, and data-availability tiers); factor exposure and quantile grouping (computed on the calculation surface, with explicit layer counts and outlier handling, IC incl. Pearson/Spearman, insufficient samples never used as a basis); stock-selection application (multi-factor scoring or conditional screening producing a candidate universe and target weights — scoring is not forecasting); and a no-look-ahead backtest protocol (financials dated by disclosure date, not reporting period; universe from current-period constituents; prices end at the decision date; assertions mandatory). Division of labor with the adaptive-rotation suite: rotation selects industry groups on price-based momentum, this suite selects stocks on fundamental factors — the two combine without overlap. With the single-stock research suite: that one produces in-depth reports on a single company, this one does cross-sectional ranking and screening. Factor values are always computed on the calculation surface, never by hand. Backtests are historical simulations and do not constitute investment advice.

# Wire · Portfolio Risk / 柏讯 · 组合风险

## What this is

柏讯组合风险四件套：风险预算（单票与板块上限 + 超限按比例重分配 + 迭代上限显式 + 未收敛如实报告，产出合规 TargetWeights）、回撤与波动体检（最大回撤起止/年化波动/HHI/前 N 占比/行业集中度/有效标的数 + 基准超额与跟踪误差，指标走计算面，体检不预测）、止损纪律（量级起点 -5%/-10%/20 日冷却 + 按标的波动重标 + 三处明示引擎不自动执行 + 触发检查只呈现状态不新增判断）、再平衡方案（逐标的差额/方向/股数 + 佣金印花税滑点分项成本 + 可送权重模式回测 + 不含择时）。与决策复盘套件的分工：复盘看现状（集中度/回撤/偏离），本套件定纪律（预算怎么分、止损怎么设、什么时候该动手），一静一动。与策略工坊的分工：工坊讲通用参数含义，本套件把纪律应用到用户的实际持仓上。paper-only：无真实资金；所有指标是历史与当前状态描述，不构成投资建议。

Wire Portfolio Risk, a four-skill set: risk budgeting (per-position and sector caps + proportional reallocation on breach + an explicit iteration cap + honest reporting when it fails to converge, producing a compliant TargetWeights instance), drawdown and volatility checkup (max drawdown start/end, annualized volatility, HHI, top-N weight, sector concentration, effective number of holdings, plus benchmark excess return and tracking error — indicators come from the compute plane and a checkup predicts nothing), stop-loss discipline (magnitude anchors -5%/-10% and a 20-day cooldown + volatility-based re-scaling per holding + three explicit statements that the engine never auto-executes + trigger checks that present status without adding judgments), and a rebalancing plan (per-holding delta / direction / share counts + itemized commission, stamp tax and slippage costs + a weight rule submittable to weight-mode backtest + no market timing). Division of labor with the Decision Review suite: review looks at the present state (concentration / drawdown / drift); this suite sets the discipline (how to split the budget, where stops go, when to act) — one static, one active. Division of labor with the Strategy Lab: the lab explains generic parameter meanings; this suite applies the discipline to the user's actual holdings. Paper-only: no real money; every indicator describes history and current state and does not constitute investment advice.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

# Wire · Adaptive Rotation Suite / 柏讯 · 自适应轮动套件

## What this is

自适应行业轮动：从市场状态判定（慢速趋势/回撤/波动率 Z + 快速冲击）到组强度排序（申万 L1 成分股合成的行业指数）、组内排序（残差动量 + 稳健 Z + 例外框架）、风险预算建仓（产出 TargetWeights 契约实例）与闭环运行（权重模式回测 + 模拟盘 + 快照解读）。对齐 FinRL-X 的七个策略模块，但输入已按 A 股适配：波动率用已实现波动率（QVIX/iVIX 在柏讯可及环境不可达），组用申万成分股合成（官方指数序列未采），参数按实测分位重标（原 Z≥3.0 → 采用 |Z|≥2.0，因实测 3.0 只占 0.47%）。价格走通道 B（本地 DAAS，需先播种 A 股），统计一律由 fd-quant 计算面产出。与「策略工坊」的分工：工坊给通用纪律（权重语义、回测解读、风控归属），本套件给**具体策略与参数**（选哪些组、组内选谁、预算怎么分）；督导不重复实现。终产物是可执行权重与运行记录，不是买入建议。

Adaptive industry rotation: from market-regime classification (slow trend/drawdown/volatility Z plus a fast shock check) to group-strength ranking (industry indices synthesized from SW Level-1 constituents), intra-group ranking (residual momentum + robust Z + an exception framework), risk-budgeted position building (emitting TargetWeights contract instances) and closed-loop operation (weight-mode backtests + paper trading + snapshot reading). Aligned with FinRL-X's seven strategy modules, but inputs are adapted to A-shares: volatility uses realized volatility (QVIX/iVIX are unreachable from Wire's reachable environment), groups are synthesized from SW constituents (official index series not sampled), and parameters are re-calibrated to measured quantiles (original Z≥3.0 → adopted |Z|≥2.0, since measured 3.0 covers only 0.47%). Prices go through channel B (local DAAS; A-shares must be seeded first); statistics are always produced by the fd-quant compute face. Division of labor with the strategy-lab suite: the lab provides general discipline (weight semantics, backtest interpretation, risk-control ownership), this suite provides the concrete strategy and parameters (which groups, which names within a group, how the budget splits); supervision does not re-implement. The end product is executable weights and run records, not buy advice.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData



## How to obtain

Three paths, all landing the same frozen version snapshot:

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): open the market tab, search "Wire · Adaptive Rotation Suite", subscribe and install.
2. In a CLI-capable editor (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, ZCode):

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install noL2XKaTZP2kiERrC_gtKA

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

## What it contains

Skills (4):
- rotation-regime — 柏讯自适应轮动 · 市场状态判定（套件入口）。当用户要求判断当前 A 股市场处于进攻/中性/防守状态、要求给出轮动的择时前提、或问"现在该不该加仓/降仓"时使用。产出：带证据的 risk_on / neutral / risk_off 判定
- rotation-ranking — 柏讯自适应轮动 · 组与组内排序。当用户要求"哪些行业值得配""组内选哪几只""为什么这个组落选"时使用。组 = 申万 L1（31 类）成分股合成的行业指数；组强度用信息比排序，组内用残差动量 + 稳健 Z。产出：组排序表 + 组内排序表 
- rotation-portfolio — 柏讯自适应轮动 · 风险预算建仓与风控参数。当用户要求"按排序结果给个仓位方案""组之间怎么分配""止损怎么设"时使用。产出：TargetWeights 契约实例（组权重 → 资产权重）+ 风险预算依据 + 风控参数（并明确止损须在策略内表
- rotation-run — 柏讯自适应轮动 · 闭环运行与解读。当用户要"把这份权重跑一下""回测结果怎么看""模拟盘为什么没成交/权重为什么偏了"时使用。产出：权重模式回测结果（含成本与基准）+ 权重快照解读 + 偏离归因。终产物是可执行权重与运行记录，不是一段买入

Statutes via Lex semantic search with article-level parsing, validity status via data-business search, similar and guiding cases via the judgment and guiding-case libraries; S10 now verifies citation authenticity by cross-checking with the data tools.

# Wire · Info Shock / 柏讯 · 信息冲击

## What this is

柏讯信息冲击四件套：冲击识别（先查来源健康度，游标拉取+检索补漏两路，按来源三型与七组冲击类型初筛，逐条附 item_id、发布时间与正文状态）、冲击解读（读正文抽金额/比例/期限/主体/生效条件五要素，结论分明确与需看条件两栏，每条结论附证据块：item_id + as_of + 经 locate_evidence 核对的原文逐字片段；强断言缺可定位证据时只作「据标题/摘要，正文未核实」弱表述）、影响窗口统计（前窗 5 日基准 + 后窗 5/10/20 日并列，样本量、分位、离散度与必选的反例比例随表输出，样本不足整表标注「不作依据」）、信息流跟踪（来源与类型计数、期间对比、健康度水位，滞后与不可用前置「信息可能不完整」）。与事件驱动套件的分工：事件驱动走 fd-cn-report 公告面，本套件走 info-stream 统一信息条目（公告+部委+互动），以 item_id 为引用锚点、以逐字证据为结论门槛。核心纪律：健康度前置（引用前先查 stream_health，lag 超阈值声明信息可能不完整，空结果不得写成没有事件）、不预测（不给涨跌预期）、正文支撑（标题只是检索入口）、历史分布非预测（样本量与反例比例强制随表）。不构成投资建议。

Wire Info Shock four-skill set: shock identification (source health first, then cursor pull plus retrieval as two complementary paths, initial triage by three source types and seven shock-type groups, each item with item_id, publish time and body status), shock reading (read the body and extract five element classes — amount, ratio, horizon, party, effectiveness condition — with conclusions split into 'explicit' vs 'depends on conditions'; every conclusion carries an evidence block: item_id + as_of + a verbatim quote verified through locate_evidence; strong assertions without locatable evidence are downgraded to 'per title/abstract, body unverified'), impact-window statistics (front 5-day baseline vs back 5/10/20 trading days side by side, sample size, quantiles, dispersion and a mandatory counterexample ratio accompany every table; insufficient samples mark the whole table 'not to be relied on'), and stream tracking (source and type counts, period comparison, health watermark; lags and outages are prefixed 'information may be incomplete'). Division of labor with the event-driven suite: event-driven works the fd-cn-report announcement face, this suite works info-stream unified items (announcements + ministries + interactions), with item_id as the citation anchor and verbatim evidence as the bar for conclusions. Core discipline: health first (check stream_health before citing; if lag exceeds the threshold, declare 'information may be incomplete'; never report an empty result as 'no events'), no prediction (no up/down expectations), body-text support (a title is only a search entry), historical distribution is not forecast (sample size and counterexample ratio are mandatory). Not investment advice.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData



## How to obtain

Three paths, all landing the same frozen version snapshot:

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): open the market tab, search "Wire · Info Shock", subscribe and install.
2. In a CLI-capable editor (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, ZCode):

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install tXQaAuRY2F-Kog-rb21bCw

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

## What it contains

- shock-detection — 柏讯信息冲击 · 冲击识别。当用户要求"最近有什么新公告/新信息""把今天的信息流筛一遍""找出可能构成信息冲击的条目"时使用。先查来源健康度，再按游标拉信息流（list_since），按来源三型（公告/部委/互动）与七组冲击类型做初筛，逐
- shock-reading — 柏讯信息冲击 · 冲击解读。当用户要求"这条公告/这条信息说了什么""把关键条款摘出来""这个消息的具体金额和条件"时使用。读条目正文，抽取金额/比例/期限/主体/生效条件五类要素，结论分"明确（正文要素直接支撑）"与"需看条件"两栏；每条
- shock-window — 柏讯信息冲击 · 影响窗口统计。当用户要求"这类公告发布前后一般怎么走""这条信息的历史前后窗口表现""前后窗口指标偏离多大"时使用。对同类信息冲击做多窗口（默认前窗 5 日基准 + 后窗 5/10/20 个交易日）的历史统计：样本量、分位
- shock-watch — 柏讯信息冲击 · 信息流跟踪。当用户要求"帮我盯着信息流""每天把新条目按来源和类型筛一遍""给我一张信息流跟踪表"时使用。按来源与冲击类型筛选条目流，输出条目清单、来源计数、期间对比与来源健康度水位；滞后与不可用如实标注"信息可能不完整"

- legal-corpus-explorer — 五源法律语料检索与口径对照。当用户要查部门规章/地方规章、条约、纪检监察法规、人民法院案例库案例、党内法规，或要在多个语料源之间对照同一问题的规范口径、找某领域除法律外的细化规定（"部门规章怎么规定的""有没有条约""党内法规怎么要求""案
- statute-lifecycle-tracker — 法规效力生命周期追踪与所在层级查证。当用户要了解某部法规的效力状态（有效/已修改/已废止/尚未生效/未知）、核对一部法规是否被后续修法改动、盘点某一领域的现行有效法规存量、或要判断"某个规定还有效吗""这部法改过几版"时使用。以效力状态为权

# Xingyan Academy / 星研·学院

星研·学院首辑两课：①《壹座上手》——从零完成第一个可交付任务：文档库、功能集安装、真实工具调用、trace 自检、分享交付；②《萬星与谦面协作入门》——把技能与 MCP 组装成个人工作流，部署为可被程序调用的服务（A2A、访客页、控制台）。安装后你的助手兼任助教，按课逐步带你动手完成。

Xingyan Academy's first release, two lessons: 1) 'Getting Started with Yizuo' — your first deliverable: document library, pack install, a real tool call, trace check, sharing; 2) 'Intro to Wanxing and Facet Collaboration' — assemble skills and MCP into a personal workflow, deployed as a callable service (A2A, visitor page, console). Your assistant doubles as a teaching assistant and walks you through each lesson.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData



## How to obtain

Three paths, all landing the same frozen version snapshot:

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): open the market tab, search "Xingyan Academy", subscribe and install.
2. In a CLI-capable editor (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, ZCode):

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install bQ-NlOBloZegGfkiczktDA

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

- xingyan-academy-wanxing-facet — 星研·学院《萬星与谦面协作入门：搭起你的第一个个人工作流》（build 层）伴学技能：把壹座里装好的技能与 MCP 组装成属于你的个人工作流（自建预设），把它部署到萬星成为一个可被程序调用的服务，并用一条 A2A 请求、一个访客对话页和控制

# Infra Factory Fleet / 工厂集群

## What this is

工厂集群：Owner 自用的三岗运行编制——巡检岗按可计数阈值观测全部在册集群与基础设施并逐条目落异常清单；优化岗把已确认异常只经既有提案面转为配置/蓝图/技能/跨面提案并附条目依据；报班岗按周汇总异常台账、提案四态计数与成本走势，拍板件走 decision_queue 正式呈报。提案与批准分离：红线动作永远人工，批准前零写动作。 含集群模板 fleet 段（三岗编排：巡检→优化→报班；装包后经壹座「团队→从模板实例化」建队）。

Owner-facing three-post fleet: the sentinel audits all registered fleets and infrastructure against countable thresholds and lands a per-item anomaly ledger; the optimizer routes confirmed anomalies through existing proposal surfaces only, each citing its ledger entry; the shift lead delivers a weekly digest and puts decisions in the decision queue. Proposals and approvals stay separate; red-line actions are always human.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData



## How to obtain

Three paths, all landing the same frozen version snapshot:

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): open the market tab, search "Infra Factory Fleet", subscribe and install.
2. In a CLI-capable editor (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, ZCode):

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install bKipx4urGfO5TE6GjJ9Ihg

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

## What it contains

Skills (3):
- sentinel-discipline — 工厂集群巡检岗纪律：五类可计数阈值判据、逐条目异常清单格式、单回合口径收窄与收尾报数落 board。装配于工厂集群巡检岗。
- optimizer-discipline — 工厂集群优化岗纪律：异常→提案四通道映射、提案必附异常条目依据、幻觉源名防御、自动化政策线分级标注、批准前零写边界。装配于工厂集群优化岗。
- shiftlead-discipline — 工厂集群报班岗纪律：周报 digest 三段（异常台账/提案四态计数/成本走势）、拍板件走 decision_queue 正式呈报、禁私信替代。装配于工厂集群报班岗。

MCP server references (5): infra-telemetry, fleet-architect, blueprint-author, facet-market, actions-mcp

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud · As of: 2026-11-05

# AI Company / AI 公司

## What this is

官方团队模板样板：CEO 巡视（{{fleetContext}} 注入）+ 三真数据岗（开源/投资）+ 助理引用岗 + 两连接器空态岗（电商/内容，演示待补岗降级）+ 萬星团队 a2a optional 成员（演示依赖缺位降级）。pack 自带 agents 上限 3（铸造实证），故助理为 existing-persona 引用岗；编导段为 supervisor 式 dispatch——CEO 可向各部门派活（显式 dispatch 边，非全舰 implicit）。铸造上架时 packId/占位符按铸造脚本补齐；本文件是清单真源，测试钉住其必须通过 fleet 段预校验。

Official team-template showcase: CEO patrol ({{fleetContext}} injected) + three real-data roles (open source / investment) + an assistant reference role + two connector empty-state roles (e-commerce / content, demonstrating pending-role degradation) + a Wanxing team a2a optional member (demonstrating missing-dependency degradation). The pack ships with an agents cap of 3 (forge-verified), so the assistant is an existing-persona reference role; the scripted section uses supervisor-style dispatch — the CEO can assign work to departments (explicit dispatch edges, not fleet-wide implicit). At forge-and-list time the packId and placeholders are completed by the forge script; this file is the manifest's source of truth, and tests pin that it must pass the fleet-section pre-validation.

# Avatar Workshop / 分身工坊

## What this is

和工坊助手聊几句，它把你的知识变成一个可发布的 AI 分身：采访你、整理语料、生成接待人设与 manifest.json，给出发布三步指引。造好的分身部署后，任何人从目录点「和这个分身聊」就能了解你——费用你出（hosted），访客免费。

Chat with the workshop assistant for a few rounds and it turns your knowledge into a publishable AI avatar: it interviews you, organizes your corpus, generates the reception persona and manifest.json, and hands you a three-step publishing guide. Once the avatar is built and deployed, anyone can click "Chat with this avatar" in the catalog to get to know you — you cover the cost (hosted); visitors are free.

# Facet Forge / 谦面工坊

## What this is

生态创作者的铸包工坊：把一个想法做成可安装的功能集（pack）。①铸包——发现平台可用的 MCP 工具与技能、查重、组装 manifest、预校验、发布；②改编——用开源或外部技能打底时的许可证判定与署名（含降级路径与防编造约束）；③验收——发布后自查：装得上吗、工具真的被调用了吗、取不到时说得诚实吗。面向生态创作者；发布需创作者身份。

The pack-forging workshop for ecosystem creators: turn an idea into an installable pack. 1) Forge — discover the platform's MCP tools and skills, check for duplicates, assemble the manifest, pre-validate, publish. 2) Adapt — license review and attribution when building on open-source or external skills, with fallback paths and no-fabrication constraints. 3) Accept — post-publish self-check: does it install, are tools really called, honest when data is missing. Publishing requires creator status.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): open the market tab, search "Facet Forge", subscribe and install.
2. In a CLI-capable editor (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, ZCode):

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install _B99vDq0CFBNQGvmfy5iSw

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

## What it contains

Skills (3):
- facet-forge-assembly — 在谦面把想法铸成功能集（pack）：先发现可用的 MCP 工具与技能，再组装 manifest（内联技能 + MCP 引用 + 角色），预校验通过后发布。用户要「做一个功能集/预设套件/上架」「把某能力打包给用户装」「我有个想法想做成 AI
- facet-forge-adaptation — 把别人的技能（GitHub 开源技能、外部技能市场条目、谦面已上架 pack 里的技能）改编成自己的功能集内容时的合规与改编方法：许可证能不能用、怎么署名、怎么把数据环节换成平台工具。用户说"照着这个开源项目做一个""把这个技能抄过来改改"
- facet-forge-acceptance — 功能集发布之后的自查清单：确认用户装得上、装上了能用、工具真的被调用过、工具说做不到时是否诚实。用户说"我发布了这个功能集，接下来呢""怎么知道它有没有用""用户反馈装不上/用不了"时使用。

# Investment Research Morning Meeting / 投研晨会

## What this is

Official team template: a three-tier cascading investment-research morning meeting — the Chief Analyst consolidates the macro/sector researchers' morning briefs, makes the final call and reports up; the Risk Officer is a passive seat (awakened by delegation or by approval of an escalation). Demonstrates: three-tier organization ({{fleetContext}} injects only direct subordinates, the middle tier condenses upward), trading-day cadence, and escalate-driven passive seats; the scripted segments are the trigger+handoff cascade (the two researchers hand off to the Chief once their morning checks finish) and the Chief dispatching a delegation to the Risk Officer. When minted for listing, packId/agents are completed by the mint script; this file is the manifest source of truth, and tests pin that it must pass the fleet-section pre-validation.

# Micro-Business · Retail Signal Pack / 生意体检 · 零售信号包

## What this is

零售行业环境信号包（需与「生意体检 · 内核套件」叠加安装）：批发价参考（昆明国际花卉拍卖中心 kifa.net 日度拍卖价与行情分析，对花店/生鲜类是进货成本直接参考，不泛化为所有零售商品）、城市基本面（中国城市面板 209 变量 × 297 城 × 2000–2024，判断社区消费力与选址）、同业密度（工商登记，支持省份+城市+区县与行业小类颗粒度，可用 company_type 筛选个体工商户）、快递大盘景气（国家邮政局快递月报，36 期连续，兼营电商/社区团购的小店参考）。**硬边界**：工商数据最新批次 2023，滞后约 3 年，一律标注「历史格局、非实时」；数据源只有新增注册口径、无注销/吊销，「关了多少家」类问题明示做不了并给存量状态分布替代，禁止编造关店数量或估算退出率。

Retail industry environmental signal pack (install alongside the Micro-Business · Core Checkup Suite): wholesale price reference (Kunming International Flower Auction Center, kifa.net, daily auction prices and market analysis — a direct purchase-cost reference for florists and fresh-produce shops, not generalizable to all retail goods), city fundamentals (China city panel, 209 variables × 297 cities × 2000–2024, for judging neighborhood purchasing power and site selection), peer density (business registry with province + city + county granularity down to sub-industry, and company_type filtering for individually-owned businesses), and express-delivery climate (State Post Bureau monthly reports, 36 consecutive issues, a reference for small shops that also sell online or via community group buying). **Hard boundaries**: the newest registry batch is 2023 — roughly a 3-year lag — so every output is labeled 'historical snapshot, not real-time'; the source covers only new registrations with no deregistration/revocation scope, 'how many shops closed' questions are explicitly declined with a stock status distribution offered instead, and fabricating closure counts or estimating exit rates is forbidden.

- Official: yes — curated by FindData

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install UXWcHRYPeyNue1Z4qQl-Tw

# Micro-Business · Core Checkup Suite / 生意体检 · 内核套件

## What this is

面向中国传统微型企业与个体户的经营体检内核：四段式工作流（问诊建档 → 单店算账 → 行业信号对照 → 行动清单）为入口技能，配套盈亏平衡、毛利结构、现金流账期三个计算器。所有金额与比率一律经计算器产出并附计算公式 + 输入基数 + 来源（来源名/地区/年份/口径时间），外部统计基数取不到时该项中止并明示「基数数据源未连接/未定码」，禁止用模型记忆的行业数字填充。未安装行业信号包时如实标注「未安装行业信号包」且不中断分析。单店生意档案可建立在 DAAS 实体模型上（一家店=一个实体，指标持久化 + 告警规则）。内核按小老板能听懂的标准书写，专业术语附日常解释；机构与政务渠道共用同一内核，仅外壳与推送方式不同。

Operating-checkup core for China's micro-enterprises and sole proprietors: a four-stage workflow (intake interview → single-store accounting → industry-signal comparison → action list) as the entry skill, with three companion calculators for break-even, gross-margin structure, and cash flow/payment terms. Every amount and ratio is produced by a calculator and carries its formula, input base, and source (source name/region/year/as-of date); when an external statistical base cannot be fetched, that item halts with an explicit 'base data source not connected/uncoded' notice, and filling gaps from the model's memory of industry figures is forbidden. When no industry signal pack is installed, this is honestly labeled and the analysis continues. Single-store business profiles can be persisted on the DAAS entity model (one store = one entity, with persistent indicators and alert rules). The core is written so small-business owners can understand it, with plain-language explanations for technical terms; institutional and government channels share the same core and differ only in shell and delivery.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData



## How to obtain

Three paths, all landing the same frozen version snapshot:

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): open the market tab, search "Micro-Business · Core Checkup Suite", subscribe and install.
2. In a CLI-capable editor (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, ZCode):

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install MBcXTHtyyMOxDHmSUYvDdQ

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

## What it contains

Skills (4):
- mb-business-checkup — 生意体检（谦面·面向个体户与微型企业的内核入口技能）。当小老板描述自己的店（餐馆/便利店/花店/网店）、或代账、银行普惠客户经理、园区运营要为商户做经营诊断时使用。四段式：问诊建档 → 单店算账（点名盈亏平衡/毛利结构/现金流账期三计算器）
- mb-breakeven-calculator — 盈亏平衡计算器（谦面·面向个体户与微型企业的三个原子计算器之一）。当小老板或代账要算「一个月卖到多少才不亏」「每天要来多少客人/多少单才保本」「离保本线还有多远」「按现在的流水多少天能 cover 固定成本」时使用。产出月盈亏平衡流水、保本
- mb-margin-structure-calculator — 毛利结构计算器（谦面·面向个体户与微型企业的三个原子计算器之一）。当小老板或代账要算「毛利有多少」「哪块成本占得最重」「房租人工占流水几成」「涨价能多赚多少」时使用。产出固定/变动成本拆分、各项成本占流水比、毛利率与边际贡献率、成本结构诊断
- mb-cashflow-terms-calculator — 现金流与账期计算器（谦面·面向个体户与微型企业的三个原子计算器之一）。当小老板或代账要算「手里要留多少周转金」「什么时候会缺钱」「供应商账期和客户账期对不上怎么办」「旺季备货钱够不够」时使用。产出最少周转金、现金流缺口时段与金额、账期占款、

MCP server references (2): fd-find-data-business-mcp, fd-daas-mcp

# Customer Support Crew / 客服班组

## What this is

官方团队模板：高频客服护航——客服组长每 4 小时带队巡检工单，一线客服处理、质检员抽检；组长对疑难工单用 escalate 合并上报（演示对抗每日防洪上限的上报纪律）与 CRM 客服工具面（凭据未配置时如实空转，不整体失败）。恰 3 岗满编无引用岗；编导段演示入站唤醒：event 边 bot:{{SERVICE_BOT}} 入站唤醒一线客服（客服 bot 为运营期配置的通道实例，缺位由运行期如实判定），一线 report 上行组长、组长可 dispatch 直接派单一线。铸造上架时 packId/agents/占位符按铸造脚本补齐；本文件是清单真源，测试钉住其必须通过 fleet 段预校验。

Official team template for high-volume support — the support lead sweeps the ticket queue with the team every 4 hours, front-line agents handle tickets, and the QA inspector spot-checks; tough tickets are batched up with escalate (demonstrating reporting discipline against the daily flood cap) on the CRM support tool surface (when credentials are unconfigured it idles truthfully instead of failing the whole run). Exactly 3 roles, fully staffed, no reference roles; the choreographed segment demonstrates inbound wake-up: the event edge bot:{{SERVICE_BOT}} wakes the front-line agent on inbound traffic (the support bot is a channel instance configured during operations; its absence is determined truthfully at runtime); the front line reports up to the lead, who can dispatch tickets directly back to the front line. When minted for listing, packId/agents/placeholders are completed by the minting script; this file is the true source of the manifest, and tests pin that it must pass the fleet-section pre-validation.

# Micro-Business · Catering Signal Pack / 生意体检 · 餐饮信号包

## What this is

餐饮行业环境信号包（需与「生意体检 · 内核套件」叠加安装）：食材成本趋势（大连商品交易所期货：生猪/豆粕/玉米/棕榈油，餐饮最大变动成本项的趋势预警，不等于菜市场现货价）、商圈活跃度代理（专资办电影票房日榜/周榜，2017 起可回溯，反映商圈消费活跃度而非本店客流）、堂食外卖切换代理（中央气象台天气，34 省 2529 站时级，结构性提示而非客流预测），并可选查同业密度（工商登记区县 + 行业小类）。每个信号均标注代理性质与局限；信号源不可用时标注「未连接」且不填模型记忆值。工商类信号带批次年份与「历史格局、非实时」标注，且明示无注销/吊销口径、不做关店量。

Catering industry environmental signal pack (install alongside the Micro-Business · Core Checkup Suite): food-cost trend (Dalian Commodity Exchange futures — live hogs/soybean meal/corn/palm oil — trend warnings for catering's largest variable-cost item, not market spot prices), a commercial-district activity proxy (national film box office daily/weekly charts, traceable back to 2017; reflects district consumption activity, not your store's footfall), and a dine-in/delivery shift proxy (Central Meteorological Observatory weather, hourly across 34 provinces and 2,529 stations; a structural hint, not a footfall forecast), plus optional peer-density lookup (business registry at county + sub-industry granularity). Every signal is labeled with its proxy nature and its limits; when a source is unavailable it is marked 'not connected' and never filled with model-memory values. Registry-based signals carry their batch year with a 'historical snapshot, not real-time' label, and explicitly state that there is no deregistration/revocation scope and no closure counts.

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

# Text Engine · Screenplay Classics Suite / 文本引擎 · 剧本经典套件

## What this is

公版经典剧本的检索与研究：结构分析（幕场/折出骨架与情节推进）、角色检索（台词聚合与形象分析）、场景检索（按描述定位并细读整场）、相似段落（语义向量找近邻，跨用词差异找情境）。语料覆盖莎士比亚、希腊悲剧、元杂剧、明清传奇、现代话剧（老舍）、京剧，共 18 部；每个结果携带 provenance 三件套（source/stable_id/as_of）。检索走 fd-text-core 引擎的混合通道（关键词 CJK bigram + 繁简归一 ⊕ 语义向量 Qwen3-Embedding-8B）。

Retrieval and research over public-domain classic plays: structure analysis (act/scene skeleton and plot progression), character search (line aggregation and character-portrait analysis), scene search (locate by description and close-read a whole scene), and similar passages (semantic-vector nearest neighbors that find matching situations across differing wording). The corpus covers 18 works — Shakespeare, Greek tragedy, Yuan zaju, Ming–Qing chuanqi, modern spoken drama (Lao She), and Peking opera; every result carries the provenance triplet (source/stable_id/as_of). Retrieval runs through the fd-text-core engine's hybrid channel (keywords CJK bigram + traditional/simplified normalization ⊕ semantic vectors via Qwen3-Embedding-8B).

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install 1mAJYooWE-SajhzqTNMhBw

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

- screenplay-structure-analysis — 剧本结构分析（文本引擎·剧本包入口技能）。当用户想了解一部戏剧/戏曲的幕场骨架、情节推进、折出结构，或要求梳理某剧的场次脉络、剧情大纲时使用。驱动从结构骨架到情节脉络的分析流程，数据经 fd-text-core 引擎的剧本语料实时检索。
- screenplay-character-search — 剧本角色检索与分析（文本引擎·剧本包）。当用户想查某个人物在某部剧里说了什么、出场段落、角色形象分析，或要求"找出哈姆雷特的独白""窦娥的唱词""这个角色在全剧中的台词"时使用。按角色名驱动台词级检索，数据经 fd-text-core 引擎
- screenplay-scene-search — 剧本场景检索与细读（文本引擎·剧本包）。当用户想查某部剧的某个具体场景（"哈姆雷特的戏中戏""窦娥临刑那场""西厢记的送别"）、某个情境段落、或要求细读某场戏的完整内容与调度时使用。按场景描述驱动检索，数据经 fd-text-core 引擎
- screenplay-similar-passages — 剧本相似段落检索与比较（文本引擎·剧本包）。当用户给出一段剧本文字想找"类似的其他段落"、要求跨剧对比相似情境（如"还有哪些戏写了临刑发誓""找和这段相似的独白"）、或做母题/桥段溯源时使用。按参考文本的语义向量找近邻，数据经 fd-tex

# Text Engine · Paper Research Suite / 文本引擎 · 论文研究套件

## What this is

学术论文的检索与研究：文献综述（方向定位与脉络梳理）、方法追踪（提出/变体/应用谱系）、相关工作（语义相似文献与对比矩阵）。语料覆盖 arXiv q-fin 与 cs.CL 等八个类目的千级样本（元数据 + 摘要，CC0 元数据）；外部开放检索（arXiv/OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar）编排补充。**版权红线**：只返回元数据、摘要、切块引用与指回 arXiv.org 的原文链接，本服务不提供也不外发论文全文。检索走 fd-text-core 引擎的混合通道（关键词 ⊕ 语义向量 Qwen3-Embedding-8B）。

Retrieval and research over academic papers: literature review (framing the direction and mapping the thread), method tracking (lineage of proposals/variants/applications), and related work (semantically similar papers and comparison matrices). The corpus covers thousand-scale samples across eight arXiv categories including q-fin and cs.CL (metadata + abstracts, CC0 metadata); external open search (arXiv/OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar) is orchestrated as a supplement. **Copyright red line**: only metadata, abstracts, chunked quotes, and links pointing back to arXiv.org are returned — this service neither provides nor sends out full paper texts. Retrieval runs through the fd-text-core engine's hybrid channel (keywords ⊕ semantic vectors via Qwen3-Embedding-8B).

- Species: pack (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: yes — curated by FindData



## How to obtain

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install 1OQ93FLBzzVGcn2js31ADA

3. From the market page: https://agent.finddatatech.cloud/#/packs

## What it contains

Skills (3):
- paper-literature-search — 论文文献检索（文本引擎·论文包入口技能）。当用户想查某个研究方向的论文、做文献综述、了解某领域有哪些工作、或要求"找找关于 XX 的论文""这个方向的研究现状"时使用。驱动从方向定位到文献梳理的流程，数据经 fd-text-core 引擎的
- paper-method-tracking — 论文方法追踪（文本引擎·论文包）。当用户想查某个方法/技术（如 transformer、对比学习、GARCH）在学术论文里怎么用、有哪些变体、谁提出的，或要求"追一下 XX 方法的发展"时使用。按方法名驱动检索与脉络梳理，数据经 fd-te
- paper-related-work — 论文相关工作与相似文献（文本引擎·论文包）。当用户给出一段摘要/题目/研究想法，要求找相似论文、写相关工作段落、或做查重式比对（"有没有做过类似的"）时使用。按参考文本的语义向量找近邻，数据经 fd-text-core 引擎实时取。

# company-valuation

## What this is

Estimate the intrinsic value of a public company using DCF, relative (peer multiple) and sum-of-parts (SOTP) methods, then triangulate to an implied share price with upside/downside versus the current market price. Use this skill whenever the user asks: "what is AAPL worth", "valuation of NVDA", "fair value of TSLA", "intrinsic value", "DCF for MSFT", "build a DCF", "discounted cash flow", "WACC", "terminal value", "implied share price", "upside to fair value", "is X overvalued/undervalued", "relative valuation", "peer comparison valuation", "EV/EBITDA target", "SOTP", "sum of the parts", "how much is [company] worth", "price target from fundamentals", "value this company", or any ticker in the context of computing intrinsic or relative valuation. Default to running ALL three methods (DCF + relative + SOTP-if-applicable) and presenting a blended implied price with a sensitivity table. Do not answer valuation questions from memory — always run the workflow.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# pa1nrui1-contract-review

## What this is

基于张海燕四步审查法+何力/常金光三观分析法，对合同进行深度审查。支持企业核验、多语言自动检测、Mermaid业务流程图、二段式审核意见、合同概览、客户可读合同编号、业务摘要、22类合同专项审查、续约提醒和 Word 修订模式审核红线稿。飞书正式交付物必须包含问题卡片列表和业务流程图；用户选择修订模式时，以原合同为只读来源，先生成 redline-plan.json，再运行 scripts/redline/apply_redline_plan.py 生成带真实修订痕迹和批注的 Word 审核修订稿，并完成红线 QA。其他记录保存为本地 Markdown。

Performs in-depth contract review based on Zhang Haiyan's four-step review method plus the He Li/Chang Jinguang three-perspective analysis method. Supports company verification, automatic multilingual detection, Mermaid business flow diagrams, two-stage review opinions, contract overviews, client-readable contract numbers, business summaries, specialized review for 22 contract types, renewal reminders, and Word tracked-changes redline review drafts. Feishu formal deliverables must include the issue card list and the business flow diagram; when the user selects revision mode, the original contract is treated as a read-only source, redline-plan.json is generated first, then scripts/redline/apply_redline_plan.py is run to produce a Word review revision with real tracked changes and comments, completing redline QA. Other records are saved as local Markdown.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://github.com/pa1nrui1/legal-skills

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# contract-drafting

## What this is

合同起草、生成合同、拟定协议、写合同、根据交易安排形成合同文本、多轮修订和最终版归档的唯一入口。基于三观四步法与用户可选配置的本地合同模板库，支持有模板时定制化起草、无模板时独立起草；输出合同草案，并同步生成客户可读合同编号、合同概览、业务摘要、版本记录、修订历史和续约提醒信息。

The single entry point for contract drafting: generating contracts, preparing agreements, writing contracts, forming contract text from transaction arrangements, multi-round revisions, and archiving the final version. Based on the three-perspective four-step method and a user-configurable local contract template library, it supports customized drafting with a template and standalone drafting without one; outputs a contract draft, and simultaneously generates a client-readable contract number, contract overview, business summary, version records, revision history, and renewal reminder information.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# engagement-contract-management

## What this is

协助律师完成委托合同签订和案件归档。签订阶段覆盖收费方式确认、授权范围确认、全套委托文书生成；归档阶段覆盖诉讼跟踪记录表生成和客户档案更新。当用户发送客户编号并提及"签订合同"、"案件建档"等指令时触发使用。

Assists lawyers with signing engagement contracts and archiving case files. The signing stage covers confirmation of the fee arrangement, confirmation of the scope of authorization, and generation of the full set of engagement documents; the archiving stage covers generation of litigation tracking record sheets and updating client files. Triggers when the user sends a client number and mentions instructions such as "sign the contract" or "create the case file".

# prosecution-review-stage-defense

## What this is

覆盖审查起诉阶段辩护律师全部工作职责的专业技能模块，包括阅卷权、会见权、调查取证权、 证据核实权、意见表达权、非法证据排除申请权、控告申诉权等七类核心权利的行使指导， 以及法律文书生成、量刑预判、与检察机关沟通策略等全流程工作规范。

A professional skill module covering all duties of the defense lawyer at the review-and-prosecution stage, including guidance on exercising seven core rights — case-file review, client meetings, investigation and evidence collection, evidence verification, expression of opinions, application for exclusion of illegally obtained evidence, and complaint and petition rights — plus full-workflow standards such as legal document generation, sentencing prediction, and communication strategy with the procuratorate.

# trial-report-generator

## What this is

从已有案件材料（起诉状、答辩状、庭审纪要、法律分析等）中提取要素，生成法院内部审理报告Word文书初稿。按总控当前事项记录和复盘台账衔接。当用户发送客户编号并提及"审理报告"等指令时触发使用。

Extracts elements from existing case materials (complaints, defenses, hearing minutes, legal analyses, etc.) to generate a draft Word document of the court's internal trial report. Links to the master controller's current-matter records and retrospective ledger. Triggers when the user sends a client number and mentions instructions such as "trial report".

# advertising-compliance-review

## What this is

广告合规审核技能，用于审核广告素材是否符合中国广告法及相关法规。适用场景：(1) 用户提交广告文案、广告素材要求合规审核时；(2) 用户提到"广告审核""广告合规""广告法审查"等关键词时；(3) 用户要求检查广告内容是否存在违法违规风险时；(4) 用户提交房地产、食品、医疗、药品、互联网等行业广告要求专项审核时。审核依据涵盖《广告法》《反不正当竞争法》及行业专项法规。

Advertising compliance review skill for checking whether advertising materials comply with China's Advertising Law and related regulations. Applicable scenarios: (1) the user submits ad copy or ad materials requesting compliance review; (2) the user mentions keywords such as "ad review", "ad compliance", or "Advertising Law review"; (3) the user asks to check whether ad content carries legal or regulatory violation risks; (4) the user submits ads from industries such as real estate, food, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or the internet for specialized review. The review basis covers the Advertising Law, the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, and industry-specific regulations.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# pretrial-preparation

## What this is

庭前准备。基于起诉状、法律分析、诉讼可视化、案例汇编、质证意见等前置文档，自动归纳争议焦点，生成争点导向型庭审提纲、质证攻防矩阵、举证策略规划表、开庭陈述提纲、法庭辩论提纲、代理词和诉讼法律服务方案。当用户发送客户编号并提及"庭前准备"、"庭审提纲"、"代理词"、"诉讼方案"等指令时触发使用。

Pretrial preparation. Based on preceding documents such as complaints, legal analyses, litigation visualizations, case compilations, and cross-examination opinions, it automatically summarizes disputed issues and generates issue-oriented trial outlines, evidence-challenge attack-and-defense matrices, evidence presentation strategy plans, opening statement outlines, courtroom debate outlines, representation statements, and litigation legal service plans. Triggers when the user sends a client number and mentions instructions such as "pretrial preparation", "trial outline", "representation statement", or "litigation plan".

# client-communication-records

Creates communication record documents for civil and commercial litigation cases. Following the requirements of the Litigation Refinement manual, it records the content of the first in-depth client communication in a dialogue-transcript format and finally generates the case communication record as a Word document. # case-discussion-outline

## What this is

AI自动完成的深度案件分析工具，整合前序材料进行四维度自问自答分析、三方模拟法庭演练，最终生成案件提纲。当用户提及"案件讨论"、"案件提纲"、"案件分析"、"模拟法庭"、"案件研讨"等指令时触发使用。立案完成后主动提醒律师执行。

An AI-automated deep case analysis tool that integrates preceding materials to perform four-dimension self-question-and-answer analysis and a three-party moot court rehearsal, ultimately generating a case outline. Triggers when the user mentions instructions such as "case discussion", "case outline", "case analysis", "moot court", or "case review". Proactively reminds the lawyer to run it after case filing is complete.

# civil-first-instance-litigation

## What this is

民事一审诉讼与破产案件专业流程编排 Skill。整合25个子Skill：民事诉讼14个（法律咨询助手、案件沟通记录、初步法律分析、委托合同管理、法规案例检索、调查取证与证据管理、立案管理、诉讼可视化、案件讨论与提纲、诉讼文书起草、庭前准备、庭审与庭后工作、调解与和解、诉讼分析工具、结案归档）+ 破产案件10个（破产法律分析、破产申请与受理、管理人工作、财产调查与管理、债权申报与审查、债权人会议、重整程序、破产和解程序、破产清算、破产文书生成）。用于判断民事/破产案件阶段（S0-S16/SM/BP系列）、推荐下一步子Skill、提示关键节点确认和期限；事项建档、路径、文件读取、来源披露、OCR 校正和缺口归档由「法律工作总控」统一处理。

Professional workflow-orchestration skill for civil first-instance litigation and bankruptcy cases. Integrates 25 sub-skills: 14 civil litigation skills (legal consultation assistant, case communication records, preliminary legal analysis, engagement contract management, statute and case retrieval, investigation and evidence collection and evidence management, case filing management, litigation visualization, case discussion and outline, litigation document drafting, pretrial preparation, trial and post-trial work, mediation and settlement, litigation analysis tools, and case closing and archiving) plus 10 bankruptcy skills (bankruptcy legal analysis, bankruptcy application and acceptance, administrator work, asset investigation and management, creditor claim registration and review, creditors' meetings, reorganization procedures, bankruptcy settlement procedures, bankruptcy liquidation, and bankruptcy document generation). Used to determine the civil/bankruptcy case stage (S0-S16/SM/BP series), recommend the next sub-skill, and flag key-node confirmations and deadlines; matter filing, paths, file reading, source disclosure, OCR correction, and gap archiving are handled uniformly by the "legal work master controller".

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# legal-consultation-assistant

## What this is

协助律师处理微信渠道法律咨询和线下咨询，提供口语化回复建议、智能反问引导、软性销售植入，并在用户明确要求或总控确认需要时更新复盘台账。支持客户编号识别、咨询入口路由、线下咨询事实补全等功能。

Assists lawyers in handling legal consultations via WeChat and offline consultations, providing colloquial reply suggestions, intelligent follow-up question guidance, and soft-sell placement, and updating the retrospective ledger when the user explicitly requests it or the master controller confirms the need. Supports client number recognition, consultation entry routing, and offline consultation fact completion.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://github.com/pa1nrui1/legal-skills


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# legal-workflow-controller

## What this is

legal 文件夹通用入口 Skill。用于法律咨询、案件办理、合同、产品法务、监管合规、诉讼、刑辩、劳动争议、破产、合规、文书、检索等任务的语义路由、案件隔离、来源披露、文件读取复查、法规/Wiki 校验、OCR 校正、缺口提示和合同偏好学习。用户提出任何法律工作请求、客户编号、案件材料处理、法律文书生成或需要自动匹配 legal 子 Skill 时触发。

General entry-point skill for the legal folder. Provides semantic routing, case isolation, source disclosure, file-read re-checking, statute/Wiki verification, OCR correction, gap flagging, and contract preference learning for tasks such as legal consultation, case handling, contracts, product legal affairs, regulatory compliance, litigation, criminal defense, labor disputes, bankruptcy, compliance, document drafting, and retrieval. Triggered when the user makes any legal work request, provides a client number, requests case material processing or legal document generation, or needs automatic matching to a legal sub-skill.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# legal-doc-pre-release-review

## What this is

在法律业务 Skill 生成正文或要素式字段后、法律文书模板与导出生成本地 Word 前触发。用于审查 draft.html/preflight-meta.json 或 complaint-data.json/fill-plan.json、读取复查摘要、法规校验摘要、来源边界和用户确认记录，决定是否可以进入正式 DOCX 导出；发现问题后必须闭环推进到业务 Skill 整改、用户确认或材料读取流程。

Triggered after a legal business skill generates the body text or element-based fields and before legal document templates are exported to a local Word file. Used to review draft.html/preflight-meta.json or complaint-data.json/fill-plan.json, the file-read re-check summary, the statute verification summary, source boundaries, and user confirmation records, and to decide whether formal DOCX export may proceed; when issues are found, closure must be driven through business-skill remediation, user confirmation, or the material re-reading flow.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# legal-doc-templates-export

## What this is

统一处理法律工作中最终需要输出本地 Word（.docx）的文书、报告、清单、笔录、意见书、函件、合同和正式交付文件。由法律工作总控强制路由调用；业务 Skill 负责正文和法律判断，本 Skill 负责选择格式 profile、接收语义 HTML 或要素式填充数据、导出 DOCX、结构体检和兜底模板。

Uniformly handles documents, reports, checklists, transcripts, opinions, letters, contracts, and formal deliverables in legal work that ultimately need to be output as local Word (.docx) files. Invoked by mandatory routing from the legal work controller; business skills are responsible for the body text and legal judgments, while this skill selects the format profile, receives semantic HTML or element-based fill data, exports the DOCX, performs structural checks, and applies fallback templates.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# statute-case-retrieval

## What this is

基于三层检索法进行系统性法律法规与案例检索，与前序"初步法律分析"请求权路径联动，输出法官版《法律法规及案例汇编》和律师版《法规案例检索报告》双文档，按总控当前事项记录和复盘台账衔接。当用户发送客户编号并提及"检索法规案例"、"法规汇编"、"案例检索"等指令时触发使用。

Performs systematic retrieval of statutes and case law based on a three-layer retrieval method, links with the claim-basis paths of the preceding preliminary legal analysis, and outputs two documents: the judge edition 'Statutes, Regulations and Case Compendium' and the lawyer edition 'Regulation and Case Retrieval Report', connected with the controller's current-matter record and review ledger. Triggered when the user sends a client number and mentions commands such as 'retrieve statutes and cases', 'statute compendium', or 'case retrieval'.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

Applicable when the user asks to monitor, for an industry, client, product, or topic, laws and regulations, regulatory policies, departmental rules, normative documents, draft rules for public comment, or enforcement developments, and to determine new-rule requirements, gaps in the client's existing compliance documents, and remediation plans.

# bankruptcy-reconciliation

## What this is

提供破产和解程序全流程支持，覆盖从和解申请、协议草案编制、债权人会议表决、协议效力确认到执行监督及转清算的完整流程。适用《企业破产法》第95-99条。当用户发送客户编号并提及"破产和解"、"和解协议"、"和解程序"等指令时触发使用。

Provides full-process support for the bankruptcy composition procedure, covering the complete flow from the composition application, drafting of the agreement, creditor meeting voting, and confirmation of the agreement's validity, through execution supervision and conversion to liquidation. Applies Articles 95-99 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law. # bankruptcy-document-generator

## What this is

基于《破产程序法律文书样式》中的165份文书模板（106份法院文书+59份管理人文书），按需生成各类破产程序文书。本Skill作为破产文书的统一生成工具，供其他破产Skill调用。当用户发送客户编号并提及"破产文书"/"生成XX通知"/"生成XX报告"/"生成XX裁定"等指令时触发使用。

Generates all kinds of bankruptcy-procedure documents on demand based on the 165 document templates in the 'Model Styles of Legal Documents for Bankruptcy Proceedings' (106 court documents + 59 administrator documents). This skill serves as the unified generation tool for bankruptcy documents and is called by other bankruptcy skills. Triggered when the user sends a client number and mentions commands such as 'bankruptcy documents', 'generate XX notice', 'generate XX report', or 'generate XX ruling'.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)

# bankruptcy-legal-analysis

## What this is

基于《企业破产法》及司法解释，进行破产案件的系统性法律分析，支持管理人、债权人代理、债务人代理三种角色视角，生成标准化破产法律分析报告Word文档。当用户发送客户编号并提及"破产法律分析"、"破产分析"指令时触发使用，或在破产案件流程中自动衔接（BP1→BP2）。

Performs systematic legal analysis of bankruptcy cases based on the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law and its judicial interpretations, supporting three role perspectives - administrator, creditor's counsel, and debtor's counsel - and generating a standardized bankruptcy legal analysis report as a Word document. Triggered when the user sends a client number and mentions the commands 'bankruptcy legal analysis' or 'bankruptcy analysis', or automatically chained within the bankruptcy case flow (BP1→BP2).

# litigation-visualization

## What this is

基于Mermaid语法生成诉讼可视化图表（法律关系图、时间轴图、争点树、要件分析图、攻防对抗图、证据链图谱），按总控当前事项记录和复盘台账衔接，生成诉讼可视化报告Word文档（法官版+律师版）。当用户发送客户编号并提及"可视化"、"诉讼可视化"、"制作图表"等指令时触发使用。

Generates litigation visualization charts in Mermaid syntax (legal-relationship diagram, timeline, issue tree, element analysis diagram, offense-defense confrontation diagram, evidence-chain graph), connects with the controller's current-matter record and review ledger, and produces a litigation visualization report as a Word document (judge edition + lawyer edition). Triggered when the user sends a client number and mentions commands such as 'visualization', 'litigation visualization', or 'make charts'.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://github.com/pa1nrui1/legal-skills

# litigation-document-drafting

## What this is

基于"六来源体系"和请求权基础分析，起草起诉状、答辩状、代理词、质证意见、保全申请书等诉讼文书。整合《法律文书汇编》（郑州市律师协会2023年度优秀法律文书汇编）格式标准，按总控当前事项记录和复盘台账衔接。当用户发送客户编号并提及"起诉状"、"答辩状"、"代理词"、"质证"、"保全"等指令时触发使用。

Drafts litigation documents such as complaints, statements of defense, attorney arguments, cross-examination opinions, and preservation applications based on the 'six-source system' and claim-basis analysis. Integrates the format standards of the 'Compendium of Legal Documents' (the Zhengzhou Lawyers Association 2023 compendium of outstanding legal documents) and connects with the controller's current-matter record and review ledger. Triggered when the user sends a client number and mentions commands such as 'complaint', 'statement of defense', 'attorney argument', 'cross-examination', or 'preservation'.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# litigation-case-management

## What this is

民事、刑事及劳动争议诉讼共用的案件运营管理 Skill。用于案件更新、传票/开庭通知/举证通知/应诉通知/裁判文书处理、期限台账、飞书日历提醒、事实时间线和程序时间线维护、飞书思维导图同步、案件简报、诉讼案件总览、案件组合状态、案件关闭与结案归档检查。案件隔离、建档、材料读取复查、来源披露、OCR 校正、缺口归档和法规核验由法律工作总控统一处理。

Case operations management skill shared by civil, criminal, and labor dispute litigation. Used for case updates, handling of summonses/trial notices/evidence notices/response notices/judgment documents, deadline ledgers, Feishu calendar reminders, maintenance of fact and procedural timelines, Feishu mind-map sync, case briefings, litigation case overviews, case portfolio status, and case closing with closure-archive checks. Case isolation, file creation, file-read re-checking, source disclosure, OCR correction, gap archiving, and statute verification are handled uniformly by the legal work controller.

# food-label-compliance

## What this is

预包装食品标签合规审核技能，用于审核食品标签是否符合 GB 7718（预包装食品标签通则）和 GB 28050（预包装食品营养标签通则）。适用场景：(1) 用户提交食品标签图片、文字或文档要求合规审核时；(2) 用户提到"食品标签审核""标签合规""营养标签审查""GB 7718""GB 28050"等关键词时；(3) 用户要求检查食品标签是否存在缺项、错误或违规风险时。支持 2011 版和 2025 版标准。

Prepackaged food label compliance review skill, used to review whether food labels conform to GB 7718 (General Standard for the Labeling of Prepackaged Foods) and GB 28050 (General Standard for Nutrition Labeling of Prepackaged Foods). Applicable when: (1) the user submits food label images, text, or documents for compliance review; (2) the user mentions keywords such as 'food label review', 'label compliance', 'nutrition label review', 'GB 7718', or 'GB 28050'; (3) the user asks to check food labels for missing items, errors, or violation risks. Supports both the 2011 and 2025 versions of the standards.

# case-progress

## What this is

案件进度与状态台账管理。案件 case.yaml 的唯一写入引擎（新增任务、推进任务、登记期限、更新案件阶段、校验、存量迁移），Agent 会话的进度加载与写回契约，以及案件进度监控对账。当用户或 Agent 需要"更新案件进度/推进任务/登记期限/更新案件阶段/同步案件状态/校验或迁移案件数据/查看案件结构化状态"时使用。不要用于：看板展示与周研判（用 case-dashboard）、案件建档初始化（用 new-case）。

Case progress and status ledger management. The sole write engine for a case's case.yaml (adding tasks, advancing tasks, recording deadlines, updating case stage, validation, migration of legacy data), the progress load and write-back contract for Agent sessions, and reconciliation of case progress monitoring. Use when the user or an Agent needs to 'update case progress', 'advance tasks', 'record deadlines', 'update case stage', 'sync case status', 'validate or migrate case data', or 'view structured case status'. Not for: dashboard display and weekly analysis (use case-dashboard), case file initialization (use new-case).

# code2patent

## What this is

从已开发代码项目中提取技术实现证据，围绕候选专利方案生成算法/软件类说明书式技术交底书，并以“权利要求布局卡 → 发明专利初稿”两步法继续生成接近可申报版的中国发明专利起草材料。触发场景包括：读取代码仓库后撰写技术交底书、将人工总结的专利方案映射到具体实现、从代码中挖掘可专利技术方案、为专利代理师准备权利要求布局和发明专利初稿。

Extracts technical implementation evidence from developed code projects, generates algorithm/software specification-style technical disclosure documents around candidate patent solutions, and, via a two-step method of 'claim layout card → invention patent first draft', further produces drafting materials for Chinese invention patents close to a filable version. Trigger scenarios include: writing technical disclosures after reading a code repository, mapping manually summarized patent solutions to concrete implementations, mining patentable technical solutions from code, and preparing claim layouts and invention patent first drafts for patent agents.

# legal-case-analysis

## What this is

本技能应在用户需要基于案件材料、咨询材料、合同资料、证据材料或检索结果进行法律分析、案件研判、风险评估、诉讼策略、刑事案件研判与审查起诉分析、非诉风险判断、客户说明或法律分析报告时使用。它是法律任务的前置分析引擎，不要求每次都生成正式报告。不要用于：单纯 OCR、单纯法条案例检索、单纯 Word 排版转换、仅需包装服务方案且无需新增法律分析的文档生成。

Use this skill when the user needs legal analysis, case assessment, risk evaluation, litigation strategy, criminal case assessment and review-for-prosecution analysis, non-litigation risk judgment, client explanations, or legal analysis reports based on case materials, consultation materials, contract documents, evidence, or retrieval results. It is the upstream analysis engine for legal tasks and does not require generating a formal report every time. Not for: OCR alone, statute/case retrieval alone, Word layout conversion alone, or document generation that only packages a service proposal without new legal analysis.

# legal-text-format

## What this is

将法律文本（法律条文或法律案例）转换为规范的 Markdown 格式，删除推广冗余信息。本技能应在用户需要处理法律条文（如民法典、刑法等）、整理法律案例（如最高法典型案例、裁判文书等）、或从粘贴文本中格式化法律文档时使用。注意：本技能只负责格式化和内容清理，不包含内容抓取能力。内容获取应由其他 skill（如 wechat-article-fetch）完成，AI 会自动判断技能协作顺序。内置 archive 机制，所有结果自包含存储在 skill 目录内。

Converts legal texts (statutes or cases) into well-formed Markdown and removes promotional redundant content. Use this skill when the user needs to process statutes (e.g., the Civil Code, the Criminal Law), organize cases (e.g., Supreme People's Court typical cases, judgment documents), or format legal documents from pasted text. Note: this skill only handles formatting and content cleanup; it has no content-scraping capability. Content fetching should be done by other skills (e.g., wechat-article-fetch), and the AI will automatically determine the collaboration order. Includes a built-in archive mechanism; all results are self-contained and stored within the skill directory.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.

# legal-visualization

## What this is

Legal Visualization。面向法律业务场景的法律图解与图表生成技能；当用户要求把案件材料、合同材料、合规事项、交易安排、证据链、诉讼流程、时间轴、法律关系、客户汇报、法律服务方案或律师团队工作整理成关系图、流程图、时间轴、证据链、风险图、路线图、PNG/SVG/PDF/.drawio 时使用；也兼容“法律可视化”“案件事实图”“法律关系图”等说法。先按受众、任务动词和路由规则筛选场景，再生成可交付图片，并保留 draw.io 源文件作为可编辑底稿。本技能不用于事实核验，也不替代法律结论判断。

Legal Visualization. A skill for legal diagrams and chart generation in legal business scenarios; use when the user asks to organize case materials, contract materials, compliance matters, transaction arrangements, evidence chains, litigation processes, timelines, legal relationships, client reports, legal service proposals, or lawyer team work into relationship diagrams, flowcharts, timelines, evidence chains, risk maps, roadmaps, or PNG/SVG/PDF/.drawio outputs; also compatible with phrasings like 'legal visualization', 'case fact diagram', or 'legal relationship diagram'. Scenarios are first screened by audience, task verbs, and routing rules, then deliverable images are generated, with draw.io source files retained as editable drafts. This skill is not for fact verification and does not substitute for legal conclusion judgment.

# new-case

## What this is

将案件/咨询/商标/专利材料整理成标准化目录结构。支持诉讼案件（12目录）、潜在项目/咨询（2目录）、商标案件（按业务子类型选 2 个模板：注册 7 目录含独立商标注册证/异议复审无效 8 目录含独立商标注册证）、专利案件（按业务子类型选 3 个模板：申请 7 目录/复审无效 8 目录/检索其他 4 目录，目录顺序按项目进展）四种预设。本技能应在用户需要创建新案件、初始化案件目录结构、整理咨询材料、接收商标/专利新业务、或通过参数和自然语言指定案件编号、委托人、案件类型等信息快速创建案件时使用。不要用于：单独生成法律文书、进行法律研究、证据分析等非案件初始化任务。

Organizes case/consultation/trademark/patent materials into a standardized directory structure. Four presets: litigation cases (12 directories), prospective projects/consultations (2 directories), trademark cases (2 templates by business sub-type: registration, 7 directories including an independent trademark registration certificate; opposition/review/invalidation, 8 directories including an independent trademark registration certificate), and patent cases (3 templates by business sub-type: application, 7 directories; review/invalidation, 8 directories; search and others, 4 directories, with directory order following project progress). Use this skill when the user needs to create a new case, initialize a case directory structure, organize consultation materials, onboard new trademark/patent business, or quickly create a case by specifying case number, client, case type, etc. via parameters and natural language. ## What this is

以资深律师分阶段办案思维，结合 RAG 法律知识库检索，为用户提供法律问题初步诊断与行动策略。当用户描述法律纠纷、咨询"怎么办""能不能告""会不会坐牢"、询问欠钱不还/被起诉/打官司/维权/赔偿/工伤/交通事故/租房纠纷/遗产继承/离婚/合同纠纷/消费者权益/公司劳动争议等场景，或要求分析合同/侵权/劳动/家事/行政/公司股权问题，或上传法律文件时触发。不适用于出具正式法律意见书、代写文书或替代律师出庭。支持分层精读策略、多轮换词搜索、结构化引用清单（含效力状态标注）、快速/专家双模式。内置反幻觉保障机制（绝对溯源+时效性验证+幻觉自检清单），确保法条引用可溯源、案例裁判经核验、失效法条自动标注。

Provides preliminary diagnosis and action strategies for legal questions in the staged case-handling mindset of a senior lawyer, combined with RAG retrieval from a legal knowledge base. Triggered when the user describes a legal dispute, asks 'what to do', 'can I sue', 'will I go to jail', asks about unpaid debts / being sued / going to court / rights protection / compensation / work injury / traffic accidents / rental disputes / inheritance / divorce / contract disputes / consumer rights / company labor disputes, requests analysis of contract / tort / labor / family / administrative / company equity issues, or uploads legal documents. Not suitable for issuing formal legal opinions, ghostwriting documents, or substituting for a lawyer in court. Supports a layered close-reading strategy, multi-round synonym search, structured citation lists (with validity status annotations), and quick/expert dual modes. Built-in anti-hallucination safeguards (absolute source tracing + timeliness verification + hallucination self-check checklist) ensure statute citations are traceable, case rulings are verified, and repealed provisions are automatically flagged.

刑事辩护二审阶段工作Skill，覆盖上诉审委托接案、一审材料衔接、阅卷审查、会见策略、争取开庭、书面辩护意见、二审庭审、不开庭审理沟通、裁判分析及发回重审衔接。当用户提及"二审"、"上诉"、"抗诉"、"争取开庭"、"发回重审"、"二审辩护"等关键词时触发使用。

Skill for second-instance criminal defense work, covering appeal-stage case intake, hand-over of first-instance materials, case-file review, client meeting strategy, seeking an oral hearing, written defense opinions, second-instance court hearings, communication for non-oral review, judgment analysis, and remand-for-retrial hand-off. Triggered when the user mentions keywords such as 'second instance', 'appeal', 'prosecutor's protest', 'seek an oral hearing', 'remand for retrial', or 'second-instance defense'.
