# legalskill-legal-consultation

## What this is

为律师、法务提供法条检索、法规查询、案例研究、判例检索、指导案例查找、司法解释解读、合同审查与专业研判，为普通公众提供法律咨询、案件分析和维权指导。适用于普通用户描述日常纠纷、追问法律后果或寻求行动策略，即使用户未使用法律术语，常见说法如欠钱不还、被起诉、打官司、合同违约、离婚、抚养权、抚养费、探视权、家暴、彩礼、遗产继承、劳动纠纷、工伤、加班费、年终奖、竞业限制、违法解除、违法辞退、裁员、被辞退、经济补偿、年休假、交通事故、车祸、租房押金不退、消费者投诉、公司股权争议、合伙纠纷、股权代持、股东知情权、拆迁补偿、行政处罚、行政复议、知识产权侵权、商标侵权、专利纠纷、著作权纠纷、商业秘密、不正当竞争、房屋买卖纠纷、物业纠纷、邻里纠纷、名誉权侵权、隐私泄露、网络暴力、医疗事故、医疗纠纷、保险合同纠纷、人身损害、被人打了、食品安全、产品责任等，或问"怎么办""能不能告""会不会坐牢""能赔多少""胜算大吗""有什么风险""要赔多少钱""会不会被拘留""会不会判刑""能不能缓刑""怎么应诉""如何反诉""如何上诉""打官司要多久""证据不足怎么办""对方不履行怎么办""律师费多少""仲裁和诉讼哪个好""要不要请律师""自己辩护行不行""调解书有法律效力吗""强制执行怎么申请""被列入失信名单怎么办""被当成老赖怎么办""对方转移财产怎么办""判决后不执行怎么办""取保候审要什么条件""能不能不起诉"等。也覆盖律师、法务的高频专业任务：按案号查案例、按裁判要旨找类案、法条沿革追溯、法条效力核实、合同条款分析与漏洞审查、违约赔偿计算、劳动关系认定、竞业限制审查、裁判口径对比与各地裁判标准差异分析、合规审查、诉讼风险评估、仲裁策略设计、调解方案拟订、强制执行与财产保全分析、刑事报案可行性初评、证据链梳理、庭审准备提纲、再审申请、执行异议、破产债权申报等。用户上传合同、判决书、起诉状、答辩状、仲裁申请书、执行申请书、律师函等法律文件时自动触发分析，支持多轮追问与策略细化。不适用于出具正式法律意见书、代写法律文书、代理出庭、学术写作或非中文法律检索。

Provides lawyers and in-house counsel with statute retrieval, regulation lookup, case study, precedent search, guiding-case lookup, judicial-interpretation analysis, contract review, and professional assessment; provides the general public with legal consultation, case analysis, and rights-protection guidance. Suits ordinary users describing everyday disputes, asking about legal consequences, or seeking action strategies, even when they use no legal terminology. Common phrasings include: owing money and not repaying, being sued, going to court, breach of contract, divorce, custody, child support, visitation rights, domestic violence, betrothal gifts (caili), inheritance, labor disputes, work injuries, overtime pay, year-end bonus, non-compete restrictions, unlawful termination, unlawful dismissal, layoffs, being dismissed, severance compensation, paid annual leave, traffic accidents, car crashes, unreturned rental deposits, consumer complaints, corporate equity disputes, partnership disputes, nominee shareholding, shareholders' right to information, demolition compensation, administrative penalties, administrative reconsideration, IP infringement, trademark infringement, patent disputes, copyright disputes, trade secrets, unfair competition, property sale disputes, property management disputes, neighborhood disputes, reputation infringement, privacy leaks, cyberbullying, medical malpractice, medical disputes, insurance contract disputes, personal injury, being assaulted, food safety, product liability, and the like; or questions such as "What should I do?", "Can I sue?", "Will I go to jail?", "How much compensation can I get?", "Are my chances good?", "What are the risks?", "How much do I have to pay?", "Will I be detained?", "Will I be sentenced?", "Can I get probation?", "How do I respond to the suit?", "How do I counterclaim?", "How do I appeal?", "How long does a lawsuit take?", "What if the evidence is insufficient?", "What if the other party does not perform?", "How much are attorney fees?", "Arbitration or litigation — which is better?", "Do I need a lawyer?", "Can I defend myself?", "Is a mediation agreement legally binding?", "How do I apply for compulsory enforcement?", "What if I am placed on the dishonesty list?", "What if I am treated as a deadbeat debtor?", "What if the other party transfers assets away?", "What if the judgment is not enforced?", "What are the conditions for release on bail pending trial?", "Can there be no prosecution?", and the like. It also covers the high-frequency professional tasks of lawyers and in-house counsel: finding cases by case number, finding similar cases by holding, tracing the revision history of provisions, verifying provision validity, contract clause analysis and loophole review, breach-damages calculation, labor-relationship determination, non-compete review, comparison of adjudication approaches and analysis of regional differences in adjudication standards, compliance review, litigation risk assessment, arbitration strategy design, drafting mediation plans, enforcement and asset-preservation analysis, preliminary feasibility assessment of criminal complaints, evidence-chain mapping, trial-preparation outlines, retrial applications, enforcement objections, bankruptcy claim filing, and more. Analysis is triggered automatically when the user uploads legal documents such as contracts, judgments, complaints, statements of defense, arbitration applications, enforcement applications, or attorney letters; multi-turn follow-up questions and strategy refinement are supported. Not suitable for issuing formal legal opinions, ghost-writing legal documents, court representation, academic writing, or non-Chinese legal research.

# legal-industry-report

## What this is

输入一个行业（可选区域与业务方向），输出一份可交付的精排 A4 PDF 行业法律调研报告。设计风格采用律所蓝皮书体例（深蓝主色 + 白色页面 + 衬线大标题 + 顶部品牌带），内置 report-profile.md 个性化配置（律所抬头 / 配色 / 主办律师 / 封面变体 / 联系方式），数据源来自企查查 MCP（企业名录 + 司法/经营风险标签）+ 网络检索（政策文件、产业园名录、产业链结构）。建议在用户说"做一份行业调研报告 / 见客户前先了解下 XX 行业 / 这周要去 XX 行业跑客户帮我准备背景资料 / 开拓新行业之前知己知彼"时使用；不要用于：客户名下的具体法律意见、对单一企业的尽调（用 opc-legal-counsel）、按周推送的对外研报（用 weekly-legal-briefing）。

Takes an industry as input (with optional region and business focus) and produces a deliverable, finely typeset A4 PDF industry legal research report. The design follows the law-firm blue-paper style (dark blue as the primary color + white pages + large serif headlines + top brand banner), includes a built-in report-profile.md personalization config (law-firm letterhead / color scheme / lead attorney / cover variants / contact details), and draws data from Qichacha MCP (company directory + judicial/operational risk tags) plus web search (policy documents, industrial park directories, industry chain structure). Recommended when the user says "prepare an industry research report / help me get to know industry XX before meeting a client / I'll be visiting clients in industry XX this week, prepare background material for me / know yourself and the other side before expanding into a new industry". Do not use for: specific legal opinions under a client's matter, due diligence on a single company (use opc-legal-counsel), or externally distributed research pushed weekly (use weekly-legal-briefing).

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# legal-abductive-reasoning

## What this is

法律溯因推理（Abductive Reasoning）技能，用于在证据不完整、事实模糊时生成并评估最合理的解释性假设。结合米尔五法（求同、求异、求同求异、剩余、共变）进行结构化因果推断。当用户需要"提出可能的法律解释"、"生成辩护/起诉假设"、"评估证据的多种解读"或"基于不完整事实推断最佳解释"时触发。适用于案例分析、证据评估、规则适用争议、因果关系推断等场景。

A legal abductive-reasoning skill for generating and evaluating the most plausible explanatory hypotheses when evidence is incomplete and facts are ambiguous. Combines Mill's five methods (agreement, difference, joint method of agreement and difference, residues, concomitant variation) for structured causal inference. Triggered when the user needs to "propose possible legal explanations", "generate defense/prosecution hypotheses", "evaluate multiple readings of evidence", or "infer the best explanation from incomplete facts". Suits case analysis, evidence assessment, disputes over rule application, causal inference, and similar scenarios.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# normative-meaning-argumentation

## What this is

分析法律规范的目的、价值导向，以及事实应如何进入规范评价，判断涵摄的限度，需要适当区别于法律解释中的规范目的解释。

Analyzes the purpose and value orientation of legal norms, and how facts should enter normative evaluation, determining the limits of subsumption; must be appropriately distinguished from teleological (normative-purpose) interpretation within legal interpretation.

# analogical-reasoning

## What this is

当AI智能体需要处理以下情形时触发本技能： 1. 当前案件/问题在现行法律中没有直接、明确的规定（法律漏洞）； 2. 需要参考已有判例、相似案件或相近法律规范来推导当前问题的处理方案； 3. 用户明确要求"参照""比照""类推适用"某一规范或案例； 4. 在法律论证中需要以"相似案件相似处理"（Like cases should be treated alike）原则支撑结论； 5. 需要评估两个或多个案件/规范之间的相似性与差异性，以判断能否进行类比； 6. 在合同解释、侵权责任认定、行政处罚裁量等场景中，需要借助类似情形的处理经验形成论证。 本技能的核心是：识别相似性基础（tertium comparationis），论证类比的正当性，并在此基础上得出合理的法律结论。

Triggers when the AI agent needs to handle the following situations: 1. The current case/issue has no direct, explicit provision in existing law (a legal gap); 2. Existing precedents, similar cases, or related legal norms must be consulted to derive a solution for the current issue; 3. The user explicitly requests "referring to", "applying by correspondence", or "analogical application of" a norm or case; 4. A legal argument needs the principle that "like cases should be treated alike" to support its conclusion; 5. The similarity and differences between two or more cases/norms must be assessed to judge whether an analogy can be drawn; 6. In contract interpretation, tort liability determination, administrative penalty discretion, and similar scenarios, experience from analogous situations is needed to build the argument. The core of this skill is to identify the basis of similarity (tertium comparationis), justify the analogy, and on that basis reach a sound legal conclusion.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://github.com/THUYRan/Legal-Skills-Chinese

# argument-chain-construction

## What this is

当AI智能体需要将法律推理结果组织为完整、自洽、有说服力的论证结构时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 撰写法律意见书、代理词、辩护词、答辩状等法律文书中的论证部分 - 回答用户提出的复杂法律问题，需要多步骤推理并呈现结论 - 对争议焦点进行系统性分析，需要构建从事实到法律到结论的完整推理路径 - 反驳对方观点时，需要构建替代性论证链条 - 对多个法律问题进行综合分析，需要确保各论证之间逻辑一致、互不矛盾 - 在法律研究备忘录中呈现分析结论 触发信号关键词：论证、分析、推理、为什么、证明、理由、论述、阐述观点、法律分析

Triggers when the AI agent needs to organize legal reasoning results into a complete, self-consistent, persuasive argument structure. Typical trigger scenarios include but are not limited to: drafting the argumentation sections of legal documents (legal opinions, statements of representation, defense statements, statements of defense); answering complex legal questions that require multi-step reasoning and a presented conclusion; systematically analyzing disputed points, requiring a complete reasoning path from facts to law to conclusion; constructing an alternative argument chain when rebutting the other side's view; comprehensively analyzing multiple legal issues while ensuring logical consistency and non-contradiction across arguments; presenting analysis conclusions in legal research memoranda. Trigger keywords: argumentation, analysis, reasoning, why, proof, grounds, exposition, articulating a viewpoint, legal analysis.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# argument-strength-evaluation

## What this is

当AI智能体完成一段法律推理或论证后，需要对该推理结论进行自我评估，判断论证的整体强度与置信度，识别并标注推理链条中的薄弱环节。 触发条件包括但不限于： - 完成法律分析后需要给出结论可靠性评级 - 用户明确要求评估某一论证的说服力或可靠性 - 存在多个竞争性法律解释需要比较论证强度 - 推理过程中涉及不确定因素（事实不明、法律空白、争议观点）需要标注 - 为决策者提供风险提示，说明结论的局限性 - 对己方或对方的法律论证进行攻防强度评估 - 在法律意见书、备忘录等文书中需要附加置信度说明

Triggers after the AI agent completes a piece of legal reasoning or argumentation and needs to self-assess the reasoning conclusion, gauge the overall strength and confidence of the argument, and identify and flag weak links in the reasoning chain. Trigger conditions include but are not limited to: assigning a reliability rating to a conclusion after legal analysis; the user explicitly asking to evaluate the persuasiveness or reliability of an argument; multiple competing legal interpretations whose argument strength must be compared; uncertainties in the reasoning (unclear facts, legal gaps, disputed views) that need flagging; providing decision-makers with risk warnings about a conclusion's limitations; assessing the offensive/defensive strength of one's own or the opponent's legal arguments; attaching a confidence statement in documents such as legal opinions and memoranda.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.

# case-retrieval

## What this is

当用户需要查找与当前法律问题相关的类似案例、相关判决、裁判规则时触发此技能。典型触发场景包括：用户明确要求查找类似案例或判例；需要通过既往裁判支撑法律论点；进行案件预判需要参考同类判决；撰写法律文书需要引用权威案例；分析某一法律问题的司法实践趋势；对比不同法院、不同时期对同一问题的裁判立场。关键词包括但不限于：类似案例、相关判决、判例检索、裁判规则、同类案件、指导性案例、典型案例、司法观点、裁判要旨等。

Triggers when the user needs to find similar cases, related judgments, or adjudication rules relevant to the current legal issue. Typical trigger scenarios include: the user explicitly asks to find similar cases or precedents; past rulings are needed to support a legal argument; predicting a case outcome requires reference to judgments of like cases; drafting legal documents requires citing authoritative cases; analyzing the trends of judicial practice on a legal issue; comparing the adjudication positions of different courts or periods on the same issue. Keywords include but are not limited to: similar cases, related judgments, precedent search, adjudication rules, like cases, guiding cases, model cases, judicial views, gist of rulings, and the like.

# conflict-resolution

## What this is

当AI智能体在法律推理过程中遇到以下情形时触发本技能：(1)多个法律条文均可适用于同一事实（法条竞合）；(2)不同证据之间存在矛盾或不一致（证据矛盾）；(3)案件存在多个争议焦点需要确定审理或分析顺序（争点优先级排序）；(4)不同法律渊源（法律、法规、司法解释、地方性法规等）对同一问题作出不同规定（法源冲突）；(5)当事人主张与法律适用之间存在张力需要协调。本技能是法律推理的核心枢纽能力，几乎所有复杂法律分析都会涉及某种形式的冲突解决。

Triggers when the AI agent encounters the following situations during legal reasoning: (1) multiple legal provisions can apply to the same facts (concurrence of provisions); (2) contradictions or inconsistencies among different pieces of evidence (evidence conflict); (3) multiple disputed issues requiring an order of trial or analysis (prioritization of issues); (4) different sources of law (statutes, regulations, judicial interpretations, local regulations, etc.) providing differently on the same issue (conflict of legal sources); (5) tension between a party's claims and the applicable law that needs reconciling. This skill is the core hub capability of legal reasoning; almost all complex legal analysis involves some form of conflict resolution.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

Source repository: https://github.com/THUYRan/Legal-Skills-Chinese

# counterfactual-reasoning

## What this is

当需要评估'如果某一事实/行为/条件不存在或发生改变，法律结果将如何不同'时触发此技能。典型触发场景包括：因果关系认定（若无该行为，损害是否仍会发生）、过错与责任比例划分、损害赔偿范围确定、合同违约损失计算、行政行为合法性假设检验、刑事因果关系中断判断、立法影响评估等。核心方法是构建一个与现实世界仅在目标变量上不同的'反事实世界'，比较两个世界的结果差异，从而得出目标变量对结果的贡献程度。

Triggers when one needs to assess "how the legal outcome would differ if a given fact/action/condition did not exist or changed". Typical trigger scenarios include: causation determination (would the harm still occur absent the act), apportioning fault and liability shares, defining the scope of damages, calculating contract breach losses, hypothesis-testing the legality of administrative acts, judging interruptions of criminal causation, assessing legislative impact, and the like. The core method is to construct a "counterfactual world" that differs from the real world only in the target variable, compare the outcome differences between the two worlds, and thereby derive the target variable's degree of contribution to the outcome.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.

# deductive-reasoning

## What this is

基于形式逻辑执行严密的法律演绎推理。当用户要求"分析案件逻辑"、"验证法律推理"、"提取三段论"、"梳理案件事实与法条的关系"或"判断法律论证的有效性"时使用本技能。 为用户提供基于形式逻辑的法律推理框架，将非结构化的法律规范与案件事实转化为有效、可检验、可复现的演绎论证链条（P-F-C）。

Performs rigorous legal deductive reasoning based on formal logic. Use this skill when the user asks to "analyze case logic", "verify legal reasoning", "extract syllogisms", "map the relationship between case facts and legal provisions", or "judge the validity of a legal argument". Provides the user with a formal-logic-based legal reasoning framework, converting unstructured legal norms and case facts into valid, testable, reproducible deductive argument chains (P-F-C).

# dispute-and-performance-risk

## What this is

当用户提交合同文本、交易安排、商业协议或法律关系描述，需要评估其中可能产生法律纠纷或违约风险时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户要求审查合同并指出潜在风险 - 用户询问某项交易安排是否存在履约障碍 - 用户描述合同执行中的困难，需要判断是否构成违约 - 用户要求对合同条款进行风险评级 - 用户提供两方或多方之间的协议，要求识别可能的争议焦点 - 用户描述已发生的履约偏差，需要评估法律后果 - 合同审查、尽职调查、交易谈判等场景中需要前瞻性风险识别 此技能聚焦于"是否会产生法律纠纷"和"是否存在违约风险"两大核心问题， 输出结构化的风险清单与应对建议。

Triggers when the user submits contract texts, transaction arrangements, commercial agreements, or descriptions of legal relations and needs to assess potential legal disputes or breach risks within them. Typical trigger scenarios include but are not limited to: the user asks to review a contract and flag potential risks; asks whether a transaction arrangement faces performance obstacles; describes difficulties in contract execution and needs to determine whether it constitutes breach; asks for risk ratings of contract clauses; provides an agreement between two or more parties and asks to identify possible disputed points; describes performance deviations that have occurred and needs the legal consequences assessed; forward-looking risk identification in contract review, due diligence, or deal negotiation. The skill focuses on two core questions — "will a legal dispute arise" and "is there breach risk" — and outputs a structured risk list with response recommendations.

# dispute-issue-identification

## What this is

争议焦点识别是指在法律要素提取之后，从法律事实中提取争议焦点，进一步将案件关系转化为法律关系问题。 能够排除无争议事项，能够有效围绕当事人争议的事实、证据和法律适用等焦点问题进行后续分析。 通过事实调查、证据审查等梳理再次确定争议焦点，可更加深入和靠近争议焦点的本质，将案件剖析的更加充分和透彻。

Disputed-issue identification: after legal element extraction, it extracts the disputed issues from the legal facts and further converts case relationships into legal-relation questions. It can exclude uncontested matters and effectively focus subsequent analysis on the parties' contested facts, evidence, and application of law. By re-determining the disputed issues through fact investigation and evidence review, it gets closer to the essence of each issue and dissects the case more fully and thoroughly.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# evidence-argument-chain

## What this is

当需要将案件中的多项证据与法律论证主张进行系统性对应挂钩时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括：准备诉讼文书（起诉状、答辩状、代理词）时需要构建完整的证据-主张对应关系； 庭审前整理证据目录并明确每项证据的证明目的；对方提出反驳后需要重新组织证据链以回应； 案件涉及多个争议焦点，需要将证据分组归类到不同论证主张下； 需要评估现有证据是否足以支撑全部主张，识别证据链中的薄弱环节和缺口。 本技能的核心是建立"主张→要件→证据→证明力评估"的完整映射关系，确保每个法律主张都有充分的证据支撑， 每项证据都有明确的证明目的，整体论证链条逻辑严密、层次清晰。

Triggers when multiple pieces of evidence in a case need to be systematically mapped to legal argument claims. Typical trigger scenarios include: building complete evidence-to-claim correspondences when preparing litigation documents (complaints, statements of defense, statements of representation); organizing the evidence list before trial and clarifying each item's probative purpose; reorganizing the evidence chain to respond after the opponent rebuts; grouping evidence under different argument claims when a case involves multiple disputed issues; assessing whether the existing evidence suffices to support all claims, and identifying weak links and gaps in the evidence chain. The core is establishing the complete mapping of "claim → element → evidence → probative-force assessment", ensuring every legal claim has sufficient evidentiary support and every item of evidence a clear probative purpose, with the overall argument chain logically tight and clearly layered.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# evidence-evaluation

## What this is

当需要对案件中的证据材料进行真实性、合法性、关联性（证据"三性"）及证明力评估时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 当事人或代理人提交证据后，需要判断该证据能否被法庭采纳 - 对方当事人对己方证据提出质证意见，需要进行回应和分析 - 需要对全案证据进行综合评判，确定待证事实是否成立 - 需要判断证据是否达到相应的证明标准（如高度盖然性、排除合理怀疑等） - 需要识别证据链中的薄弱环节并提出补强建议 - 电子数据、鉴定意见、证人证言等特殊证据形式的效力判断 - 非法证据排除的识别与论证

Triggers when the case's evidence materials need assessment of authenticity, legality, and relevance (the "three properties" of evidence) and of probative force. Typical trigger scenarios include but are not limited to: after a party or agent submits evidence, judging whether the court can admit it; responding to and analyzing the opposing party's cross-examination objections to one's own evidence; comprehensively evaluating all the case's evidence to determine whether the facts to be proven stand; judging whether the evidence meets the applicable proof standard (e.g., high preponderance, exclusion of reasonable doubt); identifying weak links in the evidence chain and proposing corroboration suggestions; determining the validity of special evidence forms such as electronic data, expert opinions, and witness testimony; recognizing and arguing the exclusion of illegally obtained evidence.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# formal-legal-consequence

## What this is

当需要根据已确认的法律事实、已识别的法律关系和已匹配的法律规范，推导出具体的法律后果（包括但不限于民事责任类型与范围、损害赔偿金额计算、刑事刑期确定、行政处罚种类与幅度、合同效力状态等）时，触发本技能。 典型触发场景包括： - 用户询问"我能获得多少赔偿""对方要承担什么责任" - 用户询问"这个行为会判几年""罚款多少" - 需要从法律构成要件满足情况推导出具体法律效果 - 需要计算具体赔偿数额、刑期范围、违约金数额等量化结果 - 需要综合考虑加重、减轻、免除等调整因素后得出最终法律后果 本技能是法律推理链条的终端环节，将抽象的法律规范转化为具体的、可操作的法律结论。

Triggers when specific legal consequences must be derived from confirmed legal facts, identified legal relations, and matched legal norms — including but not limited to the type and scope of civil liability, damages calculation, criminal sentence determination, administrative penalty types and ranges, and contract validity status. Typical trigger scenarios include: the user asks "how much compensation can I get" or "what liability will the other party bear"; asks "how many years will this act draw" or "how big is the fine"; deriving concrete legal effects from the satisfaction of legal constitutive elements; computing quantified results such as compensation amounts, sentence ranges, and liquidated damages amounts; weighing aggravating, mitigating, and exempting factors to reach the final legal consequence. This skill is the terminal link of the legal reasoning chain, converting abstract legal norms into concrete, actionable legal conclusions.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# inductive-reasoning

## What this is

当需要从一个或多个具体案例、判决、事实模式中提炼、总结出一般性法律规则、裁判规则或法律原则时，触发此技能。典型触发场景包括：用户要求从系列案例中归纳裁判要旨、从个案中提炼可推广的法律命题、从多个事实模式中识别共同法律规则、构建类案检索的裁判规则摘要、以及从实务判例中总结司法适用标准。

Triggers when general legal rules, adjudication rules, or legal principles need to be distilled and summarized from one or more specific cases, judgments, or fact patterns. Typical trigger scenarios include: the user asks to induce the gist of rulings from a series of cases, extract generalizable legal propositions from individual cases, identify common legal rules across multiple fact patterns, build adjudication-rule summaries for similar-case retrieval, and summarize judicial application standards from practice precedents.

# internal-compliance-risk-identification

## What this is

当需要对企业内部的合规管理体系进行系统性审查，识别制度缺漏、流程缺陷和数据隐私合规风险时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 企业委托律师或合规顾问进行内部合规风险评估 - 企业拟上市、并购或接受监管检查前进行合规自查 - 发生合规事件后，需要排查管理体系中的系统性缺陷 - 企业建立或更新合规管理体系时，需要评估现有制度与法律法规的匹配度 - 用户要求审查企业内部规章制度、核心业务流程或隐私政策协议的合规性 本技能覆盖三大审查维度：制度体系完整性审查、业务流程控制有效性审查、个人信息保护合规性审查。

Triggers when the enterprise's internal compliance management system needs a systematic review to identify policy gaps, process defects, and data-privacy compliance risks. The skill covers three review dimensions: completeness review of the policy system, effectiveness review of business process controls, and compliance review of personal-information protection.

## What this is

This Skill assists judges in difficult cases to identify legal value conflicts, determine the boundaries of discretion, conduct value weighing, and form an analytical framework usable for decision reasoning; it does not replace the judge in making the final ruling, but helps the judge convert value judgments into a judicial reasoning process with factual grounding, normative grounding, and argumentative structure.

# legal-concept-comprehension

## What this is

当用户要求解释、辨析、拆解或理解某个法律概念时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户直接询问"什么是XX""如何理解XX" - 用户要求比较两个法律概念的异同（如"不当得利与无因管理的区别"） - 用户给出具体事实，询问是否构成某法律概念（如"甲误将钱转给乙，是否构成不当得利？"） - 用户在法律分析、文书写作、合同审查中遇到不熟悉的术语 - 用户要求拆解某概念的构成要件或分析其法律效果 本技能是法律分析的基础单元，为法律规则适用、案件分析、法律文书写作等提供概念基础。

Triggers when the user asks to explain, distinguish, break down, or understand a legal concept. Typical trigger scenarios include but are not limited to: the user directly asks "what is XX" or "how to understand XX"; asks to compare the similarities and differences of two legal concepts (e.g., "the difference between unjust enrichment and negotiorum gestio"); provides specific facts and asks whether they constitute a legal concept (e.g., "A mistakenly transfers money to B — does this constitute unjust enrichment?"); encounters unfamiliar terms during legal analysis, document drafting, or contract review; asks to break down a concept's constitutive elements or analyze its legal effects. This skill is the basic unit of legal analysis, providing the conceptual foundation for applying legal rules, case analysis, and legal document drafting.

# legal-document-summarization

## What this is

当需要对判决书、裁定书、调解书、仲裁裁决书、行政处罚决定书等法律文书进行结构化摘要时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户要求对一份法律文书做摘要、提炼要点或生成裁判要旨 - 用户需要将多份法律文书转化为可对比、可检索的标准化摘要 - 用户要求提取案件信息、争议焦点、法律依据或说理过程 - 用户需要为案例研究、诉讼分析、教学备课准备摘要材料 - 用户要求区分不同文书类型（判决/裁定/调解/仲裁/行政处罚）的摘要重点 本技能的核心价值：在忠实于原文的基础上，将冗长法律文书转化为简明、客观、结构化的摘要，突出核心内容，避免复述全文和主观评价。

Triggers when structured summaries are needed for legal documents such as judgments, rulings, mediation agreements, arbitration awards, and administrative penalty decisions. Typical trigger scenarios include but are not limited to: the user asks to summarize a legal document, distill key points, or generate the gist of the ruling; needs to convert multiple legal documents into comparable, searchable standardized summaries; asks to extract case information, disputed issues, legal bases, or reasoning processes; needs summary material for case studies, litigation analysis, or teaching preparation; asks to differentiate summary emphases by document type (judgment/ruling/mediation/arbitration/administrative penalty). Core value of this skill: faithfully converting lengthy legal documents into concise, objective, structured summaries that highlight the core content, avoiding restating the full text and subjective commentary.

# legal-element-extraction

## What this is

当需要从案件描述、当事人陈述、聊天记录、媒体报道等非结构化文本中提取具有法律意义的事实时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户提供一段日常语言的案件描述，要求提取法律事实 - 用户要求将口语化、情绪化的叙事转化为法律分析可用的事实结构 - 用户要求区分案件叙述中的"客观事实""主观判断"和"法律评价" - 用户要求将提取的事实对应到特定法律关系的构成要件 - 用户要求整理案件时间轴或制作事实梳理表 - 用户要求将生活语言转化为法律语言（如"他一直拖着不还"→"履行期限届满后未履行"） 本技能的核心价值：将混杂的生活叙事整理为可进入法律推理的事实结构，是法律分析的前置步骤。

Triggers when legally significant facts need to be extracted from unstructured text such as case descriptions, party statements, chat records, and media reports. Typical trigger scenarios include but are not limited to: the user provides a case description in everyday language and asks to extract the legal facts; asks to convert colloquial, emotional narratives into fact structures usable for legal analysis; asks to distinguish "objective facts", "subjective judgments", and "legal evaluations" in the case narrative; asks to map the extracted facts to the constitutive elements of a specific legal relation; asks to organize a case timeline or build a fact-sorting table; asks to translate everyday language into legal language (e.g., "he keeps stalling on repayment" → "non-performance after the performance deadline has expired"). Core value of this skill: organizing mixed everyday narratives into fact structures that can enter legal reasoning — a prerequisite step of legal analysis.

- Official: no

# legal-interpretation-argument

## What this is

当法律推理过程中遇到以下情形时触发本技能： （1）法条文本含义模糊、存在多种理解可能； （2）法条适用于具体案件事实时产生争议； （3）需要论证某一法条应当/不应当适用于特定情形； （4）当事人双方对同一法条的理解存在分歧； （5）法条之间存在表面冲突，需要通过解释协调； （6）新型案件事实无法直接对应既有法条文本； （7）需要对裁判文书中的法律适用进行分析或质疑。 本技能的核心是运用文义解释、体系解释、目的解释等法律解释方法，对关键法条进行严谨的解释论证，得出合理、可辩护的法律含义，并以规范化的方式呈现解释过程与结论。

Triggers when the following situations arise during legal reasoning: (1) the meaning of a statutory text is ambiguous, with multiple possible readings; (2) applying a provision to concrete case facts is disputed; (3) it must be argued that a provision should/should not apply to a specific situation; (4) the two parties disagree on the understanding of the same provision; (5) provisions appear to conflict and need reconciliation through interpretation; (6) novel case facts cannot be directly mapped onto existing statutory texts; (7) the application of law in an adjudication document needs to be analyzed or challenged. The core of this skill is applying legal interpretation methods — literal, systemic, teleological, and others — to rigorously interpret and argue key provisions, reach reasonable and defensible legal meanings, and present the interpretive process and conclusions in a standardized way.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# legal-norm-validity-check

## What this is

当AI智能体在法律推理过程中检索到具体法律条文后，需要对该法条进行效力验证时触发此技能。 触发条件包括但不限于： 1. 智能体引用任何法律条文作为推理依据前； 2. 用户提供法条要求分析其适用性时； 3. 多个法律规范可能存在冲突需要判断优先适用时； 4. 法律文件的时间效力存疑（可能已被修订、废止）时； 5. 需要确认某规范性文件是否具有法律约束力时； 6. 跨层级、跨区域法律规范适用产生疑问时。 本技能确保智能体引用的每一条法律规范均为现行有效、层级正确、与上位法及同位法无冲突， 从而保障法律推理结论的可靠性和权威性。

Triggers when the AI agent, having retrieved specific legal provisions during reasoning, needs to verify their validity. Trigger conditions include but are not limited to: 1. Before the agent cites any legal provision as a basis for reasoning; 2. When the user provides a provision and asks for an applicability analysis; 3. When multiple legal norms may conflict and the priority of application must be judged; 4. When a legal document's temporal validity is in doubt (it may have been amended or repealed); 5. When it must be confirmed whether a normative document is legally binding; 6. When applying legal norms across levels or regions raises questions. This skill ensures every legal norm the agent cites is currently effective, at the correct hierarchy level, and conflict-free with higher-level and same-level norms, thereby safeguarding the reliability and authority of the reasoning conclusions.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.

# legal-terminology

## What this is

当AI智能体在生成、审查或修改任何法律文本（包括但不限于合同、诉状、法律意见书、裁判文书、法规释义、法律备忘录等）时，需要确保其中使用的法律术语措辞准确、无歧义、符合法律文体要求。该技能在以下场景触发： 1. 起草或修改法律文书时，需要选择正确的法律术语； 2. 审查法律文本时，发现术语使用不规范、混淆或存在歧义； 3. 将日常用语转化为法律规范表达时； 4. 翻译或对照中外法律术语时； 5. 用户明确要求对法律文本进行术语规范化处理时； 6. 对法律概念进行精确定义或解释时。 本技能是法律写作的基础原子能力，贯穿所有法律文本生产环节。

When the AI agent generates, reviews, or modifies any legal text (including but not limited to contracts, pleadings, legal opinions, adjudication documents, statute annotations, and legal memoranda), it must ensure that the legal terminology used is worded accurately, without ambiguity, and in line with legal style requirements. This skill triggers in the following scenarios: 1. selecting the correct legal terms when drafting or revising legal documents; 2. detecting non-standard, confused, or ambiguous terminology when reviewing legal texts; 3. converting everyday language into normative legal expression; 4. translating or aligning Chinese and foreign legal terms; 5. the user explicitly requests terminology normalization of a legal text; 6. precisely defining or explaining a legal concept. This skill is the foundational atomic capability of legal writing and runs through all stages of legal text production.

- Official: no

# multi-document-summarization

## What this is

当需要对多份相关文档进行综合分析、提取共同观点、识别冲突并生成统一概览时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户上传多份判决书、裁定书，要求总结类案裁判要旨 - 用户提供多个合同文本，要求归纳条款异同和关键差异 - 用户提供多份法律法规、司法解释，要求梳理规范演变和适用要点 - 用户提供多个证据材料、调查笔录，要求整合事实脉络 - 用户提供多篇学术论文、研究报告，要求提炼研究共识和分歧 - 用户要求对比多份法律意见书的观点差异 本技能的核心价值：不是简单压缩单篇文档，而是构建跨文档的关联分析，识别共性与差异，生成新的综合性洞见。

Triggers when multiple related documents need comprehensive analysis, extraction of common viewpoints, identification of conflicts, and generation of a unified overview. Typical trigger scenarios include but are not limited to: the user uploads multiple judgments or rulings and asks to summarize the gist of rulings in similar cases; provides multiple contract texts and asks to summarize clause similarities and key differences; provides multiple laws, regulations, or judicial interpretations and asks to trace normative evolution and application points; provides multiple evidence materials or investigation transcripts and asks to integrate the factual thread; provides multiple academic papers or research reports and asks to distill research consensus and disagreements; asks to compare viewpoint differences across multiple legal opinions. Core value of this skill: not simply compressing a single document, but building cross-document relational analysis, identifying commonalities and differences, and generating new synthesized insights.

- Official: no

# other-legal-retrieval

## What this is

当智能体需要检索法律条文、司法解释、典型案例之外的辅助性法律信息时触发此技能。具体包括但不限于：立法背景资料（草案说明、审议报告、立法机关答记者问）、监管案例与行政处罚决定、地方指导意见与会议纪要、部门规章的起草说明与政策解读、行业标准与技术规范、法律实施情况报告、人大常委会执法检查报告、白皮书与政策文件、学术通说与权威教材观点、域外法律比较资料等。当用户问题涉及'为什么这样规定''立法目的是什么''实践中监管部门怎么处理''地方上有什么特殊规定''行业惯例是什么'等语境时，应当触发本技能。

Triggers when the agent needs to retrieve auxiliary legal information beyond statutes, judicial interpretations, and typical cases. Specifically includes but is not limited to: legislative background materials (draft explanations, deliberation reports, legislators' press Q&A), regulatory enforcement cases and administrative penalty decisions, local guidance documents and meeting minutes, drafting explanations and policy readings of departmental rules, industry standards and technical specifications, law-implementation status reports, NPC standing-committee law-enforcement inspection reports, white papers and policy documents, academic prevailing views and authoritative textbook positions, comparative foreign-law materials, and more. This skill should be triggered when the user's question involves contexts such as "why is it regulated this way", "what is the legislative purpose", "how do regulators handle it in practice", "what special local provisions exist", or "what are the industry conventions".

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)

# strategic-risk-prioritization

## What this is

当法律分析中存在多个可能的结论、风险点或争议焦点时，需要对这些风险按照发生概率和影响程度进行系统化排序，以帮助决策者聚焦最关键的风险并合理分配资源。该技能在以下场景触发：(1)法律尽职调查中发现多项合规风险需要排序；(2)诉讼策略制定中需要评估多个不利结论的可能性与后果；(3)交易结构设计中需要识别并排列关键法律障碍；(4)合同审查中发现多个风险条款需要确定修改优先级；(5)监管合规评估中需要对多项违规风险进行分级管理；(6)任何需要在有限资源下对法律风险进行战略性取舍的场景。

When legal analysis contains multiple possible conclusions, risk points, or disputed issues, these risks need to be systematically ranked by probability of occurrence and degree of impact, helping decision-makers focus on the most critical risks and allocate resources sensibly. This skill triggers in the following scenarios: (1) multiple compliance risks found in legal due diligence that need ranking; (2) litigation strategy design requiring assessment of the likelihood and consequences of multiple adverse conclusions; (3) transaction structure design requiring identification and ordering of key legal obstacles; (4) multiple risky clauses found in contract review requiring determination of modification priorities; (5) regulatory compliance assessment requiring tiered management of multiple violation risks; (6) any scenario requiring strategic trade-offs among legal risks under limited resources.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# structured-element-extraction

## What this is

当AI智能体需要对一个法律问题、案件事实、法律条文或法律关系进行系统性分析时，首先必须将其分解为结构化的要素清单。该技能在以下场景触发： - 接收到一段案件事实描述，需要提取全部法律要素后再进行分析 - 需要判断某一法律关系是否成立（如合同成立、侵权构成、犯罪构成） - 需要对比两个或多个法律事实/条文的异同 - 在进入法律推理、法律适用、法律建议等下游任务之前，作为前置质量关卡 - 用户明确要求"列出要素""逐项分析""检查是否遗漏" 本技能的核心目标是：确保要素提取完整、无遗漏，形成可追溯、可验证的结构化清单，然后才允许进入下一阶段推理。它是法律分析链条中的"质量闸门"。

When the AI agent needs to systematically analyze a legal issue, case facts, a legal provision, or a legal relation, it must first decompose it into a structured checklist of elements. This skill triggers in the following scenarios: receiving a description of case facts that requires extracting all legal elements before analysis; determining whether a legal relation is established (e.g., formation of a contract, the elements of a tort, the elements of a crime); comparing two or more legal facts/provisions for similarities and differences; serving as a preliminary quality gate before downstream tasks such as legal reasoning, application of law, and legal advice; the user explicitly asks to "list the elements", "analyze item by item", or "check for omissions". The core goal of this skill: ensure element extraction is complete and without omissions, producing a traceable, verifiable structured checklist before the next reasoning stage is allowed. It is the "quality gate" in the chain of legal analysis.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

# systematic-interpretation

## What this is

体系解释是指针对法律规范文义解释后所产生的含义或适用范围上的争议，根据法律规范在法律体系中的位置（如在哪一部法律、编、章或节），关联的法律规范的含义，或者法律作为一个体系的应由之意，做出最符合体系性的解释，从而明确体系视角下法律规范的含义与适用范围。 触发条件（满足任一即可调用）：

Systematic interpretation addresses disputes over meaning or scope of application that arise after the literal interpretation of a legal norm, producing the interpretation most consistent with the system — based on the norm's position within the legal system (which law, part, chapter, or section it belongs to), the meanings of the related legal norms, or the sense the law must bear as a system — thereby clarifying the meaning and scope of application of the norm from a systemic perspective. Trigger conditions (any one suffices to invoke):

# teleological-interpretation

## What this is

目的解释技能。当法律条文经过文义解释后仍无法得出确定结论时，通过系统性地发现并论证该条文的目的，在文本可承受范围内选择最正当的含义，形成可裁判的解释结论。触发条件（满足任一即可）：文义解释存在两种以上可能无法择一；文义解释结论明显不合理；条文含开放性评价概念（如"合理""正当""必要""重大"）；条文较旧、面对新型事实时文义覆盖不足。

Teleological interpretation skill. When literal interpretation of a legal provision still yields no definite conclusion, it systematically discovers and argues the provision's purpose and, within what the text can bear, selects the most justified meaning to form an adjudicable interpretive conclusion. Trigger conditions (any one suffices): literal interpretation has two or more possible readings with no way to choose between them; the result of the literal interpretation is clearly unreasonable; the provision contains open-ended evaluative concepts (e.g., "reasonable", "justified", "necessary", "significant"); the provision is older and its literal coverage falls short against novel facts.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

Source repository: https://github.com/THUYRan/Legal-Skills-Chinese

民事案件九步法会话版（请求权基础 + 要件审判九步法 + 规范说）。当用户描述案情或提供起诉状/答辩状/证据/判决书，要求固定诉讼请求、找请求权基础、抗辩分析、要件拆解、类案检索、争点矩阵、举证责任分配、事实认定、裁判预测或法条/案号真实性核验时使用。输出为纯文本会话推演，不写文件系统、不调脚本。

For the first-instance stage: use when the user says 'pre-trial conference', 'suppression application', 'exclusion of illegal evidence', 'court examination', 'examination outline', 'evidence-challenge outline', 'evidence presentation and challenge', 'cross-examination', 'document-by-document challenge', 'defense presentation of evidence', or is dispatched by criminal-defense-workflow. # statute-validity-check

## What this is

法条检索与效力核查。当用户要查某法条原文、核对某条文是否现行有效、确认条号是否因修订变动、查某法律问题的法律依据（"能不能""是否有效""如何认定""依据哪一条"）时使用。语义召回候选条文后逐条锚定效力状态，输出带效力状态与 provenance 的法条清单；非"有效"版本明确标注不得作现行法。

Statute retrieval and validity verification. Use when the user wants the original text of a statute, to check whether a provision is currently in force, to confirm whether article numbers changed in a revision, or to find the legal basis for a legal question ('is it allowed', 'is it valid', 'how is it determined', 'which article applies'). After semantically recalling candidate provisions, each is anchored to its validity status; outputs a statute list with validity status and provenance; versions not 'in force' are explicitly marked as not to be used as current law.

# macro-cycle-analysis

## What this is

宏观周期与景气分析。当用户要求判断当前经济周期位置（复苏/过热/滞胀/衰退）、做六域景气扫描（增长/通胀/货币信用/财政/外贸/地产消费）、做领先-同步-滞后指标分层、识别景气拐点、梳理宏观变量到其业务问题的传导链，或做省际补充与国际对比时使用。走柏讯服务端宏观数据，不含收益率曲线与互换分析。

Macro cycle and business-climate analysis. Use when the user asks to locate the current position in the economic cycle (recovery/overheating/stagflation/recession), run a six-domain climate scan (growth/inflation/money and credit/fiscal/foreign trade/real estate and consumption), layer leading-coincident-lagging indicators, identify climate turning points, map transmission chains from macro variables to their business question, or do cross-province supplements and international comparisons. Uses 柏讯 server-side macro data; excludes yield-curve and swap analysis.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/macro-cycle-analysis


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# industry-chain-analysis

## What this is

行业景气与产业链传导分析。当用户要判断一个行业处在景气周期的哪个位置、梳理上下游投入产出与成本价格传导路径、用上市公司财务面板实证行业判断、刻画行业格局（规模/增速/集中度/进入壁垒），或把研报观点与公司真实财务数据对照时使用。走柏讯服务端行业与公司财务数据，不涉及价格与市值分析。

Industry climate and value-chain transmission analysis. Use when the user wants to determine where an industry sits in the business cycle, map upstream/downstream input-output and cost-price transmission paths, substantiate industry judgments with listed-company financial panels, characterize the industry landscape (size/growth/concentration/entry barriers), or check research-report views against companies' actual financial data. Uses 柏讯 server-side industry and company financial data; does not cover price or market-cap analysis.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# regional-economy-compare

## What this is

区域经济比较：对中国城市/省份做多维指标横向排名、分位定位、增长结构分解与相似城市聚类。当用户要比较两个或多个城市/省份的经济实力、产业结构、财政与居民收入，要某城市在全省或全国的排名与分位，要拆解经济总量增长的产业贡献与拉动点数，或要按结构找与目标城市可比的对照组时使用。数据走柏讯城市面板与统计年鉴。

Regional economic comparison: multi-dimensional indicator rankings, percentile positioning, growth-structure decomposition, and similar-city clustering for Chinese cities/provinces. Use when the user wants to compare the economic strength, industrial structure, fiscal capacity, and household income of two or more cities/provinces; wants a city's rank and percentile within its province or nationwide; wants the industrial contributions and pull points behind total growth decomposed; or wants a structurally comparable control group for a target city. Data comes from 柏讯 city panels and statistical yearbooks.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# corporate-fundamental-analysis

## What this is

企业基本面与财务质量分析（柏讯线）。当用户要求给一家 A 股上市公司做三表速览、杜邦分解、现金流质量诊断、财务红旗项排查或同业分位对照时使用。走 GTA firm-year 财务面板 + 中国财报三表与附注，输出带来源与数据期数的可复核结论。本技能只做基本面质量判断，不做估值、不给目标价。

Corporate fundamentals and financial quality analysis (柏讯 line). Use when the user asks for a quick three-statement review, DuPont decomposition, cash-flow quality diagnostics, financial red-flag screening, or peer percentile comparison for an A-share listed company. Draws on GTA firm-year financial panels plus the three main statements and notes of Chinese financial reports, producing verifiable conclusions with sources and data periods. This skill only assesses fundamental quality — no valuation, no target prices.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# panel-econometrics

## What this is

面板数据计量分析。当用户要在"个体 × 时间"二维结构上做推断时使用——固定效应/随机效应与 Hausman 检验、聚类稳健标准误、动态面板（滞后因变量）、双重差分 DID 与平行趋势/事件研究检验、断点回归概念。面板取自柏讯服务端三类源：GTA 上市公司（firm-year）、中国城市（city-year）、世界银行 WDI（country-year），宏观控制变量取柏讯宏观序列。不涉及股价与市值建模。

Panel data econometrics. Use when the user wants inference on a two-dimensional 'unit × time' structure — fixed/random effects with the Hausman test, cluster-robust standard errors, dynamic panels (lagged dependent variables), difference-in-differences DID with parallel-trends/event-study tests, and regression discontinuity concepts. Panels come from three 柏讯 server-side sources: GTA listed companies (firm-year), Chinese cities (city-year), and World Bank WDI (country-year); macro control variables come from 柏讯 macro series. Does not cover stock price or market-cap modeling.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/panel-econometrics

# statistical-inference

## What this is

统计检验与探索性分析。当用户要求做描述统计与分布诊断、选假设检验（t/ANOVA/卡方/非参）、判断两组或城市间差异是否显著、做相关性与配对分析、诊断时序平稳性与单位根、做多重比较校正，或对已有的本地 CSV/表格做探索性分析时使用。走柏讯服务端序列取数，价格类序列走本地 DAAS。

Statistical testing and exploratory analysis. Use when the user asks for descriptive statistics and distribution diagnostics, hypothesis test selection (t/ANOVA/chi-square/non-parametric), significance testing of differences between two groups or cities, correlation and paired analysis, time-series stationarity and unit-root diagnostics, multiple-comparison correction, or exploratory analysis of existing local CSV/tables. Series data is fetched via the 柏讯 server side; price-type series use local DAAS.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# equity-valuation

## What this is

股票估值（DCF + 可比公司 + 三表联动）。当用户要求给某家 A 股/港股公司做内在价值或相对估值、算 WACC 与终值、跑敏感性与情景表、给目标价区间、做同业倍数对照与反推市场隐含预期时使用。财务数据走柏讯服务端通道 A，价格与市值走本地 DAAS 通道 B；通道 B 未连接时中止估值，不给目标价。

Equity valuation (DCF + comparable companies + three-statement linkage). Use when the user asks for intrinsic or relative valuation of an A-share/HK-listed company, WACC and terminal value calculation, sensitivity and scenario tables, a target price range, peer multiple comparison, or back-solving the market's implied expectations. Financial data goes through 柏讯 server-side channel A; prices and market caps through local DAAS channel B; if channel B is not connected, the valuation halts and no target price is given.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

# earnings-cycle-analysis

## What this is

财报周期分析（前瞻 + 复盘）。当用户要求对一家公司做财报前瞻（本次披露类型与时间、该盯哪些科目、超预期/低于预期可能从哪来）、做财报复盘（实际 vs 上年同期、差异由哪个科目驱动、盈利质量如何、对后续季度意味着什么），或梳理连续数期经营动能变化时使用。基于柏讯财报与公告数据，不做技术分析。触发词：财报前瞻、业绩预告、财报复盘、业绩点评、超预期、低于预期、盈利质量、某某公司季报/半年报/年报分析。

Earnings cycle analysis (preview + recap). Use when the user asks for an earnings preview for a company (type and timing of the coming disclosure, which line items to watch, where beats/misses may come from), an earnings recap (actuals vs. the same period last year, which line items drove the difference, how earnings quality stands, what it means for coming quarters), or a mapping of operating momentum changes over several consecutive periods. Based on 柏讯 earnings and announcement data; no technical analysis. Trigger words: earnings preview, results forecast, earnings recap, results commentary, beat, miss, earnings quality, and quarterly/interim/annual report analysis of a given company.

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.

生意体检内核入口（谦面·个体户与微型企业）：四段式问诊建档→单店算账→行业信号对照→行动清单。金额与比率一律经计算器产出并附公式与基数来源；未装行业信号包时如实标注不中断。

Business checkup core entry (Facet · sole proprietors and micro-enterprises): four-stage diagnostic intake and profiling → single-store accounting → industry signal comparison → action list. All amounts and ratios are produced via calculators with formula and base source attached; if industry signal packs are not installed, this is honestly noted without interruption.

# mb-breakeven-calculator

## What this is

盈亏平衡计算器（谦面·个体户）：算月保本流水、保本客流/单量、安全边际、保本天数。每个数字附公式+基数+来源；外部基数取不到即中止该项并明示，不用模型记忆数字填充。

Break-even calculator (Facet · sole proprietors): computes monthly break-even revenue, break-even customer count/order volume, safety margin, and days to break even. Every figure comes with formula + base + source; if an external base cannot be obtained, that item halts and is explicitly stated — never filled with numbers from model memory.

# mb-margin-structure-calculator

## What this is

毛利结构计算器（谦面·个体户）：固定/变动成本拆分、各项成本占流水比、毛利率与边际贡献率、成本结构诊断。每数字附公式+基数+来源，拆分结果供盈亏平衡计算器消费。

Gross margin structure calculator (Facet · sole proprietors): fixed/variable cost split, each cost as a share of revenue, gross margin and contribution margin, and cost-structure diagnostics. Every figure comes with formula + base + source; the split results feed the break-even calculator.

现金流与账期计算器（谦面·个体户）：现金流缺口时点与金额、账期占款、最少周转金、季节性缓冲。现金流与盈亏分开呈现；每数字附公式+基数+来源。

Cash flow and payment-terms calculator (Facet · sole proprietors): timing and size of cash-flow gaps, capital tied up in payment terms, minimum working capital, and seasonal buffers. Cash flow and profit/loss are presented separately; every figure comes with formula + base + source.

# mb-signal-catering

## What this is

餐饮行业信号包（谦面·生意体检姊妹件）：食材成本趋势（大商所期货）、商圈活跃度代理（专资办票房）、堂食外卖切换代理（气象台），可选同业密度。每信号标注代理性质；工商类带批次年份与「历史格局非实时」，无注销口径不做关店量。

Catering industry signal pack (Facet · business checkup companion): food-cost trends (DCE futures), commercial-district activity proxy (专资办 box office), dine-in vs. delivery switching proxy (weather bureau), with optional peer density. Every signal is labeled with its proxy nature; business-registration signals carry their batch year and a 'historical pattern, not real-time' note; with no deregistration basis, no closure counts are produced.

# mb-signal-retail

## What this is

零售行业信号包（谦面·生意体检姊妹件）：批发价参考（昆明花拍）、城市基本面（城市面板）、同业密度（工商登记，含个体工商户筛选）、快递大盘景气。工商数据批次 2023 滞后约 3 年，标「历史格局非实时」；无注销口径，关店量明示做不了。

Retail industry signal pack (Facet · business checkup companion): wholesale price reference (Kunming flower auction), city fundamentals (city panel), peer density (business registrations, with sole-proprietorship filtering), and overall express-delivery sentiment. The business-registration data is the 2023 batch, lagging about 3 years, marked 'historical pattern, not real-time'; with no deregistration basis, closure counts are explicitly stated as unavailable.

# equity-research-data

## What this is

个股投研的取数与口径纪律层。当用户要求为某家 A 股/港股公司取财务科目、公告披露、行业财务指标或公司面板变量，或需要交代某个数字的来源工具、数据期数、币种与单位时使用。财务与披露一律走柏讯服务端通道 A，价格与市值一律走本地 DAAS 通道 B，两条通道不混用、不互相替代；取不到的数值如实声明缺口，不得填补。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/equity-research-data


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

---

# equity-research-peers

## What this is

个股投研的同业与竞争层。当用户要求为某家 A 股/港股公司挑可比公司、给同业规模与增速带对照、做可比性说明或跑倍数对照表时使用。候选池用 GTA 公司面板按规模带与增速带筛选（通道 A），价格类输入与倍数只走本地 DAAS（通道 B）；同业之间的可比性差异必须逐项标注，不得抹平。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/equity-research-peers


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# equity-research-modeling

## What this is

个股投研的估值建模与计算层。当用户要求给某家 A 股/港股公司做 DCF、DDM、可比倍数、Monte Carlo 或敏感性分析，或要求算基本面比率、跑红旗检测、把多种估值方法合成目标价时使用。全部算术一律调 fd-quant 确定性计算面（通道 Q），本技能只组织输入、标注来源、原样转述返回；计算面不可用时顶部明示"估值部分未完成"，绝不自算顶替。财务科目走柏讯服务端通道 A，价格与市值类输入走本地 DAAS 通道 B。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/equity-research-modeling

# equity-research-thesis

## What this is

个股论点综合与方向判定（Rating 契约实例）。当用户要求给某只股票下方向结论、写投资论点、列催化剂与风险、给目标价，或把取数/同行/建模三段结果收敛成一个可入决策账本的判定时使用。产出 side / conviction / price_target（可 null）/ basis / evidence；方法分歧、价格通道不可用或输入不足时扣值不扣结论。财务与披露走柏讯服务端通道 A，本地库存读数走本地 DAAS 通道 B，估值与统计量走 fd-quant 计算面通道 Q。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.

# equity-research-report

## What this is

个股投研报告装配（本套件入口技能）。当用户要求"给某只股票出一份完整研究报告""写一份研报""跑一遍个股投研流程"时从这里进入。按固定 13 章装配报告、执行六项叙述审计自检、保留缺数据章并写明原因、末尾给数据期数汇总行。串起取数与口径、同行比较、财务建模叙述、论点综合四段子流程，产出 13 章报告与一个 Rating 契约实例。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

# decision-review-log

## What this is

柏讯决策落账纪律（复盘套件入口）。当用户要求把一条判定（Rating）或目标权重（TargetWeights）记入决策账本、要求"再记一次"、要求修改或"更正"已落账的判定、或需要查回某标的的历史判定与教训时使用。账本是追加式的：幂等键 (as_of, symbol, pack, skill) 拒绝重复提交并返回既有 decision_id，修订产生新记录并以 revises 指向被修订记录，历史判定永不被就地改写。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/decision-review-log


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# decision-review-settlement

## What this is

柏讯到期结算复盘。当用户要求结算某条已落账的判定、想知道某判定"后来怎么样了"、要求汇总待结算记录、或要看原始收益与相对基准 alpha 时使用。流程为待结算汇总 → 取结算窗序列（价格走本地 DAAS 通道 B）→ 触发账本结算 → 三段式输出（判定理由回顾 + 结算结果 + 对照评述）。持有期未满不强行结算；alpha 为负不等于判断错误。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/decision-review-settlement


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# decision-review-reflection

## What this is

柏讯决策反思提炼。当用户要求为一条已结算（或已落账）的判定写复盘反思、要求"总结这次教训"、或询问为什么反思不该出现在其他角色的输出里时使用。反思固定 2–4 句，针对决策本身而非市场走势，区分"判断错"与"运气差"，并含可执行的改进项；反思由账本存储、只注入最终决策者的上下文，不得广播给其他角色，缺失反思不阻塞结算。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/decision-review-reflection


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# decision-review-portfolio

## What this is

柏讯持仓体检。当用户要求体检当前模拟账户持仓、看集中度（HHI/前 N 权重）、期间回撤、行业暴露，或核查"持仓是否偏离了最近一次判定"时使用。持仓与账户取自柏讯模拟交易服务（paper-only，模拟盘，无真实资金），统计量一律交给 fd-quant 计算面，缺失数据如实标注，结论为研究参考、不含买卖建议。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.

# strategy-design

## What this is

柏讯策略工坊 · 策略设计。当用户想把一个投资想法变成可回测的多标的策略（universe + 目标权重 + 调仓频率）、想理解权重语义（和为 1、非负、余量现金）、想取舍调仓频率与换手、或想知道哪些表达不被支持（做空/杠杆/盘中调仓）时使用。产出：一份可创建的 weight 模式策略 spec。

# strategy-backtest-interpretation

## What this is

柏讯策略工坊 · 回测解读。当用户拿到一份回测结果（尤其 walk-forward 分窗、开启成本模型、带基准对比、参数扫描）想知道"这个数字说明什么"、要求解读权益曲线与统计、或问"这能当作未来收益预期吗"时使用。核心纪律：历史模拟不预示未来；单次回测不下有效结论；不忽略成本与基准。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/strategy-backtest-interpretation

# strategy-risk-controls

## What this is

柏讯策略工坊 · 风控参数。当用户问"单票最多买多少""止损设多少""换手太高怎么办""设了会自动执行吗"——即想理解单票上限/集中度/换手/止损/冷却期这些风控参数的含义、量级参考、代价与局限时使用。核心纪律：风控参数是策略层参数，不是引擎保证。

# rotation-regime

## What this is

柏讯自适应轮动 · 市场状态判定（套件入口）。当用户要求判断当前 A 股市场处于进攻/中性/防守状态、要求给出轮动的择时前提、或问"现在该不该加仓/降仓"时使用。产出：带证据的 risk_on / neutral / risk_off 判定 + 波动率输入说明 + 参数重标表。本技能只做判定，不选股不建仓——排序与建仓交给 rotation-ranking / rotation-portfolio。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/rotation-regime


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# rotation-ranking

## What this is

柏讯自适应轮动 · 组与组内排序。当用户要求"哪些行业值得配""组内选哪几只""为什么这个组落选"时使用。组 = 申万 L1（31 类）成分股合成的行业指数；组强度用信息比排序，组内用残差动量 + 稳健 Z。产出：组排序表 + 组内排序表 + 落选原因。不建仓（交给 rotation-portfolio）。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/rotation-ranking

# rotation-portfolio

# rotation-run

## What this is

柏讯自适应轮动 · 闭环运行与解读。当用户要"把这份权重跑一下""回测结果怎么看""模拟盘为什么没成交/权重为什么偏了"时使用。产出：权重模式回测结果（含成本与基准）+ 权重快照解读 + 偏离归因。终产物是可执行权重与运行记录，不是一段买入建议。

# factor-library

## What this is

柏讯因子选股 · 因子库与口径。当用户问"有哪些基本面因子可用""这个因子怎么算""为什么这两个因子不能同时用""某个因子在 A 股跑不跑得动"时使用。收录 FinRL-X 的 52 个基本面因子（九类），逐因子给出分子、分母、所用报表、期别、取值来源、数据可得性档位与 A 股适配说明，并写明三个共线因子的剔除理由。本技能只定义因子、不计算因子值、不选股、不做因子择时。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/factor-library


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# factor-exposure

## What this is

柏讯因子选股 · 因子暴露与分层。当用户要求"算某只/某组标的的因子暴露""按因子分层看收益差""给我这个因子的 IC""这个因子在横截面上有没有区分度"时使用。暴露、分层、IC 与秩变换全部经 fd-quant 计算面完成，不在对话里手算；层数、极端值处理、样本门槛三处必须显式声明。产出：暴露表 + 分层收益表 + IC 数值与样本量。不做选股、不做因子择时。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/factor-exposure

# factor-screening

## What this is

柏讯因子选股 · 选股应用。当用户要求"按这些因子筛一批股票""多因子打分选前 N 只""把因子结论变成可回测的持仓"时使用。把 factor-exposure 的暴露与 IC 结果变成候选 universe 与目标权重，权重或规则显式写出，筛选条件逐条可解释，缺失因子按声明规则处理。产出可直接进入权重模式回测的候选名单/权重。因子打分不是预测。

# factor-backtest-protocol

## What this is

柏讯因子选股 · 无未来函数回测协议。当用户要把因子策略送进回测、要核对"这次回测有没有偷看未来"、要区分样本内与样本外、或要验某条未来数据会不会被拦住时使用。把四条点内纪律写成可核验的断言（财报按披露日、universe 用当期成分、价格止于决策日、断言必须开启），并用注入未来披露的夹具证明协议真的在拦。产出：回测口径卡 + 断言记录 + 夹具测试结果 + 样本内外分离的结论。不做因子择时、不给预期收益。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/factor-backtest-protocol


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

---

# event-detection

## What this is

柏讯事件驱动 · 事件识别与分类。当用户要求"这家公司最近有什么公告/大事""近三个月事件梳理""哪些公司发了业绩预告""把公告按事件类型分一下"时使用。三路检索（公告列表 / 分类字典 / 全文检索），把公告归入六组事件类型（业绩类、融资类、股权变动、监管类、经营类、互动类），逐条附公告标识、披露日期、上游分类与归类依据。只做识别与分类：不读正文下结论、不判断利好利空、不做反应统计（分别交给 event-reading 与 event-history）。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/event-detection


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# event-reading

## What this is

柏讯事件驱动 · 事件解读。当用户要求"这条公告到底说了什么""这个定增/减持/业绩预告怎么看""把公告关键条款摘出来"时使用。读公告正文（get_filing），抽取金额、比例、期限、主体、生效条件五类要素，把结论分成"正文要素直接支撑（明确）"与"需看条件"两栏，每条结论引用原文并给出公告标识。硬约束：未读正文不结论，标题与分类只是检索入口。不做涨跌预测，不给买卖建议；对"预期已计入"只作事实呈现与一般性提示。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/event-reading

# event-history

## What this is

柏讯事件驱动 · 历史反应统计。当用户要求"这类事件历史上发生后表现如何""业绩预增公告后 20 天一般怎么走""帮我看看这个事件类型的历史分布"时使用。对同类事件做多窗口（默认 5/10/20 个交易日）的历史反应统计：样本量、分位数、均值与离散度，并强制给出反例比例与样本门槛。全部输出为描述性历史分布，不是预测；样本不足不下结论；口径（按分类或按关键词）随结果一并写出。不提供涨跌预期、不给买卖建议。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/event-history

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# event-watch

## What this is

柏讯事件驱动 · 事件跟踪。当用户要求"帮我盯住这几家公司""每天把公告按类型筛一遍""按标的或事件类型给我一张事件跟踪表"时使用。按标的与事件类型筛选公告流，输出事件清单、分类计数与期间对比（本周 vs 上周等），并明确标注检索口径与数据截至日期。不做预告、不做推荐、不预测影响；定时触发属宿主 cron 配置，本技能只提供被调用时的方法与输出形态，不实现调度。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

# portfolio-budget

## What this is

柏讯组合风险 · 风险预算。当用户要求"资金怎么分到这些标的/行业""单票最多放多少""按上限重新分配一遍"时使用。产出：一份**生成即合规**的 TargetWeights 契约实例（单票上限 + 板块上限 + 迭代重分配，迭代上限显式，未收敛如实报告）+ 约束满足表。只管权重结构，不管"该投多少钱"；现金靠 Σweights < 1 留出，引擎不会替你扣。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/portfolio-budget

# portfolio-drawdown-review

## What this is

柏讯组合风险 · 回撤与波动体检。当用户要求"看看这个组合的回撤有多深""波动多大""是不是太集中了""和沪深300比怎么样"时使用。产出：组合级指标（最大回撤含峰谷日、年化波动、HHI、前 N 占比、板块集中度、有效标的数）+ 基准对比（超额与跟踪误差）。指标一律来自 fd-quant 计算面，不手算、不预测，缺失如实标注。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.

# portfolio-stop-discipline

## What this is

柏讯组合风险 · 止损纪律。当用户要求"止损设多少""移动止损怎么定""止损设了会自动执行吗""帮我看看哪些已经跌破线了"时使用。产出：一份用户既定的止损规则（绝对止损 / 移动止损 / 冷却期，含量级起点与按波动重标的方法与依据）+ 触发检查的状态呈现（当前值 vs 阈值 + 冷却剩余）。**本技能必须首先声明：这些是用户的纪律设定，不是引擎保证——引擎不会自动执行止损，权重模式只消费 weights_series，契约的 constraints 只有单票与板块两个上限字段，没有任何止损字段。**

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/portfolio-stop-discipline

# portfolio-rebalance-plan

## What this is

柏讯组合风险 · 再平衡方案。当用户要求"从现在的持仓调到这个目标权重，具体买什么卖什么""每只调多少股""调仓成本大概多少""这套再平衡规则历史上表现如何"时使用。产出：逐标的差额 / 方向 / 整数股数（向下取整，与权重模式引擎同口径）+ 成本预估（佣金 / 印花税 / 滑点分项，参数显式）+ 可送入权重模式回测的权重规则。**方案不含择时建议**；并明确引擎不自动执行止损、只消费 weights_series，cash_floor 只是权重上限校验而非独立持仓约束。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.

# chain-mapping

## What this is

柏讯产业链联动 · 链条映射。当用户要求"把这个行业拆成上下游""这几家公司分别在产业链哪一环""这条链的结构和关键变量是什么"时使用。产出：环节结构（上/中/下游，可多级）+ 代表标的（逐家给可解释的归属依据）+ 每环关键变量与来源 + 两档映射置信度（分类体系支持 / 公开资料推断）。只做结构映射，不做传导检验（交给 chain-transmission），不出候选（交给 chain-beneficiary）。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/chain-mapping

# chain-transmission

## What this is

柏讯产业链联动 · 传导验证。当用户说"上游涨价能不能传到中游毛利""这条链的滞后有多长""这个传导到底成不成立"时使用。产出：逐环传导检验表——每环给相关系数、时滞扫描、样本量与窗口；无数据的环节明示"未验证"，不显著的结果如实呈现，频度差显式处理。结论是历史统计关系，不是因果证明。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/chain-transmission

# chain-beneficiary

## What this is

# chain-watch

## What this is

柏讯产业链联动 · 链条景气跟踪。当用户要求"盯一下这条链最近怎么样""按环节给我看关键变量的最新走势""哪些数据好久没更新了"时使用。产出：按环节分组的变量走势表（来源 + 最新期数 + 缺口标注 + 变化方向），不含预测、不含建议。宿主 cron 可定时触发（本技能只给方法与输出形态，不实现调度）。

# ic-adjudication

## What this is

柏讯投委会 · 裁决（套件入口技能）。当用户要求"开投委会""对某只股票做一次多空辩论并给结论""裁决多头空头的分歧""把辩论结论落账"时使用。本技能是套件入口：调度 ic-bull-case 与 ic-bear-case 双方立论，然后按四条裁决纪律（冲突不给 hold 须指强弱、证据不足给 review 不降级、产出 Rating 契约实例、change_my_mind 必填）给出 Rating 契约实例，并可落账（账本不可用时明示"未落账"）。形态为单 agent 内分角色，不构成独立视角。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/ic-adjudication


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# ic-bull-case

## What this is

柏讯投委会 · 多头立论。当用户要求对某只股票构建看多论证、写多头观点、准备投委会辩论的多方意见、把证据集收敛成"为什么该买"的最强论证，或作为 ic-adjudication 的立论阶段被调度时使用。本技能不取数、不计算、不裁决——数字只能引用证据集的 evidence_id，论证组织是唯一职责。与 ic-bear-case 对称，空头未发言时不得替对手立论。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/ic-bull-case


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

---

# ic-bear-case

## What this is

柏讯投委会 · 空头立论（辩论三角色之一，与 ic-bull-case 完全对称）。当用户在投委会辩论流程中需要空头方论证、问「有什么理由不买」「多头论证哪里站不住」「估值凭什么下修」，或作为 ic-adjudication 的立论阶段被调度时使用。本技能不取数、不计算、不裁决——数字只能引用证据集的 evidence_id；不同意多头时只能提出新证据或指出其适用边界，不得改写数字。空头论证为空是合法产出，不得为对称而编造。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/ic-bear-case

# sentiment-document-review

## What this is

柏讯舆情驱动 · 公告舆情审读。当用户要求"看看这家公司最近的公告口径怎么样""给这几篇公告做个舆情判断""这些公告偏正面还是负面""公告里有什么值得注意的表述"时使用。取公告全文（巨潮面）→ 逐篇打分（fd-sentiment，分数必带原文引用）→ 呈现分数/band/置信度/引用片段与定位。多篇给分布而非平均情绪；拒答时如实转述；低置信显式标注。不做交易信号，不给情绪指数。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

# sentiment-trend-watch

## What this is

柏讯舆情驱动 · 舆情转向追踪。当用户要求"这家公司最近舆情是在变好还是变差""这段时间公告口径有没有转向""按月看公告情绪的分布变化""找出情绪转折点对应的公告"时使用。按公告发布日排布分数，给逐期分布与转向点（附对应文档），并强制报告覆盖面与置信度两栏。样本不足时明示不下转向结论。不给情绪指数、不给交易信号。

# sentiment-signal-bridge

## What this is

柏讯舆情驱动 · 舆情与价格/持仓的描述性对照。当用户要求"舆情和股价是什么关系""情绪是不是领先价格""看看公告情绪和我持仓的对应""舆情能不能当信号用"时使用。做的是描述性对照：把分数分布的时间位置与价格/持仓的时间位置并排放，说清先后与是否同期，并强制标注样本是否足以做描述性陈述。严禁给买卖建议、严禁把舆情称为信号。价格通道或账本不可用时明示降级。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/sentiment-signal-bridge


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

---

# legal-corpus-explorer

## What this is

五源法律语料检索与口径对照。当用户要查部门规章/地方规章、条约、纪检监察法规、人民法院案例库案例、党内法规，或要在多个语料源之间对照同一问题的规范口径、找某领域除法律外的细化规定（"部门规章怎么规定的""有没有条约""党内法规怎么要求""案例库里类似案件"）时使用。按封闭词表指定 source 逐源检索，逐条带 provenance；不做跨源统计与"权威解读占比"类结论。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)

# statute-lifecycle-tracker

## What this is

法规效力生命周期追踪与所在层级查证。当用户要了解某部法规的效力状态（有效/已修改/已废止/尚未生效/未知）、核对一部法规是否被后续修法改动、盘点某一领域的现行有效法规存量、或要判断"某个规定还有效吗""这部法改过几版"时使用。以效力状态为权威口径逐条核验；如实声明发布日期与失效日期字段不可用，不做趋势推断。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no

# shock-detection

## What this is

柏讯信息冲击 · 冲击识别。当用户要求"最近有什么新公告/新信息""把今天的信息流筛一遍""找出可能构成信息冲击的条目"时使用。先查来源健康度，再按游标拉信息流（list_since），按来源三型（公告/部委/互动）与七组冲击类型做初筛，逐条附 item_id、发布时间、正文状态与初筛依据。只做识别与初筛：不读正文下结论（交 shock-reading）、不做窗口统计（交 shock-window）、不预测影响。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/shock-detection


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

---

# shock-reading

## What this is

柏讯信息冲击 · 冲击解读。当用户要求"这条公告/这条信息说了什么""把关键条款摘出来""这个消息的具体金额和条件"时使用。读条目正文，抽取金额/比例/期限/主体/生效条件五类要素，结论分"明确（正文要素直接支撑）"与"需看条件"两栏；每条结论附证据块：item_id、as_of（发布时间）与经 locate_evidence 核对的原文逐字片段。硬约束：未读正文不结论；强断言缺可定位证据时只能弱表述"据标题/摘要，正文未核实"。不预测涨跌。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/shock-reading


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

---

# shock-window

## What this is

柏讯信息冲击 · 影响窗口统计。当用户要求"这类公告发布前后一般怎么走""这条信息的历史前后窗口表现""前后窗口指标偏离多大"时使用。对同类信息冲击做多窗口（默认前窗 5 日基准 + 后窗 5/10/20 个交易日）的历史统计：样本量、分位、离散度与必选的反例比例；样本不足时整表标注"不作依据"。全部输出为描述性历史分布，不是预测；价格只走通道 B，计算只走通道 Q。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/shock-window


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# shock-watch

## What this is

柏讯信息冲击 · 信息流跟踪。当用户要求"帮我盯着信息流""每天把新条目按来源和类型筛一遍""给我一张信息流跟踪表"时使用。按来源与冲击类型筛选条目流，输出条目清单、来源计数、期间对比与来源健康度水位；滞后与不可用如实标注"信息可能不完整"。不做预告、不预测影响、不做窗口统计；定时触发属宿主 cron，本技能只提供可重复执行的输入定义与输出形态。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/shock-watch


## As of

Provenance: https://facet.finddatatech.cloud/api/skills-catalog · As of: 2026-11-05

# wire-artifact-build

## What this is

柏讯产物构建。当用户要用对话把数据变成柏讯里看得见的东西——建看板（dashboard）、建正文文档（doc）、建数据录入表单（form）、建单记录扫码页（record-view）、给已有产物改 spec、发布或归档产物——时使用。所有写入一律落草稿，发布必须是独立的第二次显式调用；spec 引用的列名必须先用工具取真实列清单核对，不得凭记忆编造；上游拒绝时原样转述错误，不伪造成功。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/wire-artifact-build

# wire-data-steward

## What this is

柏讯数据治理。当用户要读表单收上来的数据、改错一条记录、撤销一次改错、查改错历史或导出 CSV 时使用。写修正必须带来源标记（source），不得代填；撤销只置回滚标记、原始行永不改写；导出结果带 truncated 字段，true 表示被上游行数闸截断而非全量——必须如实转述。任何工具失败原样转述，禁止以空列表冒充无数据。

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://gitee.com/FindDataTechnology/finddata-skills/tree/master/wire-presets/tree/main/skills/wire-data-steward

- Species: skill (plaza category enum v1)
- Official: no



## How to obtain

1. In 壹座 (Yizuo): Extensions → Skills — subscribe from the skills face.
2. Inside editors: skills reach your editor bundled with a pack that references them — install that pack with:

       npx @finddatatechnology/facet install <packId>

3. Deployed agent services receive registry skills through the registry supply channel.
Source repository: https://github.com/anthropics/skills

# MOT Data Hub Archive (交通运输部数据)

## What this is

Catalog of statistical / analysis / freight-index documents published by China's Ministry of Transport (交通运输部), crawled from the /shuju/ data hub. 4 sections (数据开放/统计数据/分析公报/运价指数) across 15 sub-archive index pages; each record is one listed document (HTML report or PDF) with title, publish date, URL, section and subsection. Paginates index.html→index_{N-1}.html (404 on overflow). Default crawl = page 1 of each archive (~270 docs); --all for full history.

- Species: official-data (plaza category enum v1)

- Anchor kind: source · native source: `mot_shuju_archive`
